920: Dehay nekuda dekaamaran, kema deit lah chulaka leella, hachi name it lah chulaka letatta beara. vehay ginta letatta, ihu chulaka dehahi nekuda leishtashea beruche detzaddikayyay beara, veithane bechol sitrin leella (vayyetze 157 amud bet) vetatta. leella betzaddik. letatta behahu ibba detzaddik, vela ishtechach shashua ella vetatta ella betzaddik. vehay ginta ihu, mehahi nekuda deikre eden (nekuda denatla meima ilaa temira ihi gan eden deara).

Innun rashe hachayya, illen arba reshe anpin. chad arye, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene arye el hayyamin. vechad shor, dichtiv ufene shor mehassemol. vechad nesher, dichtiv ufene nesher learbatan. adam kelala decholla, dichtiv udemut penehem peni adam. veillen arba reshe naharin dematulehon (sefer acher chevavn denatlin) lechuresyay kaddisha, umiggo matula dilhon zain. umehahu zia dematula dilhon, itavid hahu nahar di nur. dichtiv, (Daniel 7:10) nehar di nur naged venafek min kodamohi elef alfin yeshamshuni.

Venishmatin kad sallekin, itsachyayn behahu nahar di nur, vesallekin lekurebna vela ittokdan, ella itsachyayn. ta chaze missallamandera, deavdin minnah levusha. umiggo deihi minnura, la itsachyay hahu levusha, ella benura, eshsha achil zuhama deveh, veitsache hahu levusha. hachi name nishmeta di nur deitnetilat miggo kuresyyay kaddisha. dichtiv bah (Daniel 7:9) karseye shevivin di nur. bezimna devayay leitsachyay mehahu zuhama devah, itabberat benura veitsachyay. venura achla kol hahu zuhama di benishmeta. venishmeta itsachyay veitlabbenat.

Vei tema i hachi onsha let lah lenishmeta behay. ta chaze, vavy lenishmeta desavlat eshsha nucheraa, veaf al gav deihi itlabbena. aval kad zuhama ihu saggi alah, vavy lenishmeta desavlat hahu onsha, begin dehahu zuhama bitri zimne itlabbenat benura.

Zimna kadmaa kevan dekabbilat onsha begufa, azla nishmeta, venatle lah, veaalin lah bego atar chad deikre ben hinnom, vaamay ikre ben hinnom. ella atar chad ihu begehinnam, detamman ittzerifu nishmatin, betzirufa, leitlabbena ad la alin beginta deeden. (vei zakkain inun nishmatin kad aalayn lon behahu atar) teren malachin shelichan zeminin beginta deeden, vekayymin letara, vetzavvchin legabbe innun memanan divhahu atar degehinnam, begin lekabbela hahi nishmeta.

Vehahi nishmeta ad la itlabbenat benura, innun shelichan tzavvchin legabbayyhu, veamre hinnom. uvezimna dehi itlabbenat, innun memanan nafkin immah mehahu atar, uzemini lah legabbe pitcha deginta deeden, detamman innun shelichan veamre lon hinnom. ha innun nishmatin deha itlabbenu, keden alin lehahi nishmeta beginta deeden.

Vechamma ihi tevira miggo hahu teviru deitlabbenuta degehinnam. (sefer acher dehu) dehahi teviru deeshsha tattaa. veaf al gav denachit milella, (aval) kevan demata leara letatta, ihu eshsha dela dakik, venishmeta itansha beh, veitbarat. keden kudesha berich hu appik shimsha denahir meinnun arba pitchin denaharin birkia deal ginta, umata lehahi nishmeta veittesiat. hada hu dichtiv, (Malachi 3:20) vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe bichnafeha.

Zimna tinyayna, levatar deyatva beginta deeden diltatta, kol hahu zimna deyatva vead kean la itparshat meinnun millin dechezu dehay alma mikkol vachol. vechad sallekin lah leella, itzterich leitparsha, mikkol chezu umikkol millin diltatta. veaberu lah behahu nehar di nur, keden nishmeta itlabbenat beh mikkol vachol. venafkat veitchaziat kamme mare dealma berecha (davar acher berira) mikkol sitrin. kevan deistakkelat behahu nehora attesiat veishtelimat mikkolla. ucheden kayymin innun nishmatin bilvushin, mitatterin kamme marehon. zakkaa chulakehon
921: Veinnun nishmatin divginta deeden diltatta, shatan bechol reshe yarche veshabbatte, vesallekin ad hahu atar deikre chomot yerushala 40. detamman kama memanan uretichin denatre innun chomot. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushalam hifkadti shomrim. vesallekin ad hahu atar, vela alin lego, ad deitlabbenan. vetamman sagdin, vechaddan mehahu nehiru, vetayyvin lego ginta.

Nafkin mittamman veshatan bealma, vechaman beinnun gufin dechayyayvayya, behahu onsha dilhon, (151 amud alef) dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:24) veyyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi ki tolatam lo tamut veishsham lo tichbe vehayu deraon lechol basar. may lechol basar. leinnun shear gufin divsacharanayyhu, veha ukemuha. ulevatar meshattete umistakkelan beinnun marehon dichevin, uvene marin, veinnun desavllin al yichuda demarehon, vetavin veamrin leh limshicha.

Beshaata deamrin leh limshicha tzaara deyisrael begalutehon, veinnun chayyayvayya di behon, dela mistakkele leminda lemarehon, arim kala uvache, al innun chayyayvin divhu. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 53:5) vehu mecholal mippeshaenu medukka meavonotenu tayyvin innun nishmatin vekayymin beatrayyhu.

Beginta deeden it hechala chada, deikre hechala divni marin. keden mashiach al behahu hechala, vekare lechol marin vechol keevin, kol yissurehon deyisrael, deyetun aleh, vechullehu atyayn aleh. veilmale deihu akil mealayyhu deyisrael, venatil aleh, la have bar nash deyachil lemisbal yissurehon deyisrael, al onshe deorayyta. hada hu dichtiv (Yeshayahu 53:4) achen cholayenu hu nasha vegomer. kegavvna da ribbi elazar beara.

Begin delet chushebana, leinnun yissurin dekayymin aleh debar nash bechol yoma, al onshe deorayyta, vechullehu nachtu lealma, beshaata deityehivat orayyta. vechad havo yisrael beara kaddisha, beinnun pulechanin vekarbenin dahavo avde, havo mesallekin kol innun marin veyisurin mealma. hasheta mashiach mesalak lon mibbene alma, ad denafik bar nash mehay alma, umekabbel onsheh, kema deittemar. kad innun chovin yattir deayylin lon lego bego gehinnam, beinnun madorin tattain acharanin, umekabbelin onsha saggi missegiut zuhama di benishmeta, keden adliku nura yattir, lemechal hahu zuhama. (vavy lehahi nishmeta dasebalet hahu onsha. veal da inun Malachi chabbala dabegayhanem materadeyn lon bachevaterayn deeshsha lanearea hahu zuhama. vavy lenishmeta dasebalet hahu onesh).

Zakkain innun denatre pikkude orayyta. hahi nekuda kaddisha, deihi baya leishtashea leella uletatta beruchehon detzaddikayyay, kema (211 amud bet) deittemar. kad hahi nekuda baa leishtashea letatta beruchehon detzaddikayyay, keimma dechaddat al benaha, veishtashea behon, hachi name befalgut lelya ihi nachta veishtashea behu.

Rakia dekamran dekayyeyma al ginta, ihi kayyeyma al 4 reshe chevavn, veinnun 4 atvavn (211 amud alef) dekaamran, innun raza ded chevan. vehay rekia kayyeyma letatta (sefer acher alayyhu), kema deittemar. rakia dehahi nekuda, kayyeyma leella, al innun 4 chevavn illain dekaamran, vehahu rekia (kegavvna da min da) ihu itrekam bigvavnin kaddishin.

Behay rakia istakkelan arba chevavn, vechol innun chayyaylin letatta. kad hay rakia anhir bigvavnoy venatzitz, keden yadin kol innun retichin, vechol innun chayyaylin umashiryayn, deha tarpa dilhon izdaman. rekia da merukkema bechol gavvnin kaddishin, beh kayymin arba pitchin reshimin, bearba atvavn menatztzan.

Pitcha chada reshima listar mizrach, uveh kayyeyma behahu pitcha at chad, vehahu at ihu 1, veda natzitz vesalik venachit behay pitcha. pitcha da nahir venatzitz mintzitzu illaa. vehay at natzitz uvalit (sefer acher valehayt) begaveh, veihi nachta vesalleka, veitreshim behahu pitcha.
Pitcha tinyayna, reshima listar tzafon, uveh kayyeyma at chad, veihi at 4.
922: Veda kayyeyma venatztza, salleka venachta, velahata behahu pitcha. lezimnin natzitz bintzitzu, ulezimnin ittamar hahu nehora, vela nahir. veal da, at da la kayyeyma bekiuma tadir, veat da itreshim behahu pitcha.
Pitcha telitaa, ihu pitcha dekayyeyma listar maarav, uveh kayyeyma at chad, deitreshim veitnehir behahu pitcha. veda ihu at 50, vehay at natzitz bintzitzu behahu pitcha.

Pitcha reviaa, da ihu pitcha dekayyeyma listar darom, uveh kayyeyma reshimu dechad nekuda tattaa zeira, deitchaze vela itchaze, veda ihi at 10, veillen arba atvavn learba sitrin, (nusach acher natzeytzeyn) natztzin behahu rakia, beinnun pitchin.

Behay rakia reshimin atvavn acharanin, (davar acher 34 sitrin) bechitrin al reshayyhu. veinnun esrin uteren atvavn, mitatteran bechitrin. rekia da natil vesachara al gabbe chevavn, birshimu deatvavn, raza dechusheban deyichuda, beraza detzerufa chada veinnun: 10 10 10 10.

Illen atvavn sacharan behahu rakia, beraza deatvavn acharanin, (dirtiche) illain kaddishin setimin. veinnun atvavn acharanin (sefer acher illain) setimin, sacharin lehahu rakia, ucheden itchazyayn illen atvavn begilgula, (sefer acher dehay rekia) deinnun 10 10, ureshimin behay rekia.

Beshaata deitnehir hay rekia, itnaharan beh arba razin dishmahan kaddishin, veinnun tzirufa betzerufin ditlatin uteren shevilin. keden nachit talla mehay rekia, beinnun atvavn deraza dishma kaddisha, veittezanu kol innun retichin, vechol innun chayyaylin umashiryayn kaddishin, venatle kullehu bechedva.

Beshaata dedina talyay, illen atvavn ittemaru, veitgenizu 4 go 4, veinnun 17 13. beshaata deillen itgenizu veittamaru, keden kala distar tzafon ittear, veyade dedina sharyay al alma. uvehay rekia itreshim gavvna chada, dechalil kol gavvnin.

Kad natil hay rekia missitra demizrach, innun arba reshin dekaamran, bearba (anpin) atvavn, natlin kullehu bematlanin, vesalke bisliku leella. vechad innun natlin vesallekin leella, istallekat man deistallekat. veatvavn ithadru veitchazyayn bishlimu, beraza kadmaa, 10 10 10 10, veitrekam hahu rekia, keden itnehir binhiru.

Vechad hay rekia itnehir kemillekadmin, beillen atvavn, kullehu ithadaru veshaage lemitraf tarpa umezona. kevan deinnun shaage vesallekin kala, hahu kala ishtema leella leella, ucheden natlla birchan vekiddushan, man denatla.

Sacharan atvavn umitgalgelan, vesacharan hahu rekia, vekayyman innun atvavn listar darom. kevan dekayymin innun atvavn listar darom, sallekin venatztzan bintzitzu velahatin. keden beemtzaita dehahu rekia, reshimu chad itreshim, vehahu reshimu ihu at chad, veihu 10. kevan deat da itreshim veitchazyay, keden lahatin avatreh, telat atvavn acharanin, veinnun 16.

Illen atvavn menatztzan beemtziu dehay rekia, sallekin venachtin, melahatin bitlesar (nusach acher bitresar) lahatin. keden levatar deillen telesar zimnin melahatan, nachta man denachta, veitkelilat beinnun atvavn, veitatterat behu, vela ityeydaat. keden, kullehu chayyaylin, vechullehu mashiryayn, bechedu. vesallekin shirin vetushebchan.

Rekia da natla tinyaynut, vesachara umitgalgela, veinnun atvavn kadmae dekaamran, deinnun 10 10, kullehu itkelilu beinnun atvavn illain, raza dishma kaddisha dekaamran, vesacharan hahu rekia, vekayymin innun atvavn dahavo beemtzaita raza dishma kaddisha, kullehu itreshimu listar tzafon, veitreshimu vela itreshimu. let man deyistakkal behahu sitra, kullehu itchafyayn, veamre bekal neimu baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. itchafyyayn missitra detzafon
923: (Sefer acher deanpin) veamrin da itchafyyayn mikkol sitrin veamrin da.

Rekia da sachara kemillekadmin, veitgalgela missitra lesitra. keden kal neimu demashiryayn saggiin besitra da, vekal neimu demashiryayn saggiin besitra da, vechen led sitrin. behahi shaata hahu rekia itnehir binhiru achara, yattir mikkemma dehava, vekayyeyma binhiru begavevn achara, kelila bechol gavvnin.

Veillen atvavn dekaamran, sallekin leella behahu rekia, umekabbelin leat chad deihi illaa, deka mitchabbera bishma da, deillen atvavn. begin deaf al gav deillen atvavn dishma kaddisha, hay ihu shema deitkelil letatta, begin deraza da itkelil leella, veitkelil letatta, vechad itkelil letatta, illen atvavn sallekin lekabbelah leat chad (davar acher yod) deha mehahu at ittezanu illen atvavn letatta, vehahu at ihu 6. venachit veitchabberu illen atvavn. behahu at, ucheden kullehu beittura chada, veitavid shema shelim.

Letatta, shema shelim vela shelim. shema shelim bachamesh atvavn (davar acher velo shelim detesha atvavn, shemma shelim bechamesh atvavn) ihu, (226 amud bet) vaydod. raza dechar venukeba birmizu. shema shelim bitsha atvavn, innun Adonai elohim. da ihu shema shelim mikkolla. shema achara ihu birmizu, veihu bechamesh kidkaamran. aval da ihu shelim (Bereshit 45 amud bet) becholla.

Kevan demitchabberan illen atvavn, hahu rekia anhir bitllatin uteren nehorin, keden kolla ihu bechedvav, kolla kaim beraza chada ella vetatta. kol innun retichin, vechol innun mashiryayn, kullehu kayymin beraza dishlimu. vechol dargin metakkenan al atrayyhu, kol chad vechad kedka yeot.

Behay rekia kaim listar tzafon, chad shalhova nahir, dela shachich tadir, veihu rashim beatvavn acharanin, liyamin, veinnun eser shemahan, vesallekin leshivin shemahan, vechullehu reshimin behay rekia, venaharin kullehu kachada.

Mehay rekia, natlin kol innun rekiin diltatta, delistar kedushsha, ad dematu leinnun rekiin acharanin delistar achara, veillen ikrun yeriot izzim, kema deat amer vayyaas yeriot izzim leohel al hammishkan.

Begin deit yeriot veit yeriot, yeriot hammishkan, innun yeriot deikrun rekie chevavn demashkena kaddisha. yeriot izzim. innun rekiin (davar acher yeriot) acharanin desitra achara. illen rekiin beraza dirtichin deruchin kaddishin. veillen rekiin dilvar, dekayymin bemillin dealma, veinnun sitrin detiyyuvetin, veovadin degufa. veillen chafyayn al innun rekiin dilgo, kiklifa al mocha. rekiin dilgo innun hahu kelishu, dekayyeyma al mocha, veillen ikrun shamayim laAdonai. lishma chada da diltatta.

Rekiin acharanin leella, veinnun rekiin penimain, deikrun rekie hachayyot, deinnun raza dishma kaddisha, beraza dechevavn ravrevan illain, veillen innun razin deatvavn (sefer acher razin illain) illain, beraze deorayyta, kelala deesrin uteren atvavn, mechakkekan reshimin, denafke miggo rekia illaa teminaa. deihu rakia deal gabbe chevavn illain, vehay ihu delet leh chezu. hay ihu tamir veganiz, let beh gon.

Kol gavvnin minneh nafke. beh let gon, la itchaze, vela itgalyay, hay ihu deappik kol nehorin. beh la itchaze, la nehiru, vela chashuch, vela gon kelal, bar nishmatin detzaddikayyay, dechaman miggo rekia tattaa, kemibbatar kotala, nehiru deappik venahir hay rekia illaa, vehahu nehiru dela pasak, let man deyeda leh, let man dekaim beh.

Mittechot da, kol innun rekiin itkelilu bishma da ikre shamayim veillen (davar acher shemma kaddisha) (tikkun 115 amud bet) ikrun hashshamayim innun dishma illaa ikre behon, innun dishma kaddisha itattar behon. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 115:16) hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai, lehahu genizu dirkia illaa, dekaim
924: Ad hacha remez lishma kaddisha, (nusach acher raza deshamayim kaddishin) dekudesha berich hu ikre bishmahan. mikkan ulehala, let chakkim besachletanu, deyachil leminda uleitdabbeka kelal. bar nehiru chad zeer bela kiuma, (nusach acher kiyyuma decholla) leityayshsheva beh. zakkaa chulakeh man deal venafak, veyada leistakkela berazin demarih, uleitdabbeka beh.

Berazin illen yachil bar nash leitdabbeka bemareh, leminda shelimu dechachma beraza illaa, kad palach lemareh bitzlota, biruta, bechiuun libba, adbak reuteh kenura begachalta, leyaycheda innun rekiin tattain desitra dikdushsha, leatera lon bishma chada tattaa. umittamman ulehala leyaychada innun rekiin illain penimain, lemehve kullehu chad, behahu rekia illaa (239 amud alef) dekayyeyma alayyhu.

Uveod defumeh vesifvavteh merachshan, libbeh yechavvevn, ureuteh yistalak leella leella, leyaychada kolla beraza derazin, detamman tekiu dechol reutin umachashavin beraza dekayyeyma been sof, ulechavvevna behay bechol tzelota utzelota, bechol yoma veyoma leatera kol yomoy, beraza deyomin illain befulechanih.

Belelya yeshavve reuteh, deha itpetar mealma da, venishmateh nafkat minneh, veyihaddar lah lemare decholla, begin dechol lelya velelya, (sefer acher hahi nekuda kayyeyma, leachlela begavvav inun nishmatin detzaddikayyay).

Raza derazin leminda leinnun chakkime libba. rekia da tattaa, beraza dehahi nekuda kayyeyma, kema deamaran. hahu rekia ihu kalil meella (vayyetze 153 amud bet) umittatta, visoda dileh letatta kehay sheraga desalleka nehora uchama, (Bereshit nusach acher amud alef) leitachada binhora chivvavra, visoda dilah ihu letatta, behahi petila bemishcha. uf hachi letatta, hahi nekuda. bimama itkelilat milleella, uvelelya itkelilat mittatta, beinnun nishmatin detzaddikayyay.

Vechol millin dealma, ahadru kullehu, leikara visoda vesharasha, denafku minneh. vechamma lelavavn zeminin lenatla kol chad vechad ma deitchaze leh. kema deat amer (Tehillim 16:7) af lelot yisseruni chilyotay. nafsha azlat veshatat, vetavat lehahu ikara deitchaze lah. gufa kaim shachich keavna, veahdar lehahu atar deitchaze leh, lemishre aloy, uvegin kach tav gufa lesitreh, venafsha lesitrah.

Gufa share aloy raza desitra achara, uvegin kach istaavu yedoy, uvae leaschaa lon. kema deokimna, deha belelya kolla tav leatreh, venishmatehon detzaddikayyay sallekin veithadderan leatrayyhu, veitatterat (behu) ma deitatterat, veitkelilat michol sitrin, keden salleka yekara dekudesha berich hu veitattar mikkolla.

Belelya shaltaan memanan deitpekadu al innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay, lesalleka lon leella, ulekarva lon karban nayycha, legabbe marehon. hahu memana deitpekad al kol innun mashiryayn, (253 amud alef 154 amud alef) soriya shemeh rav memana. kevan denishmeta salleka bechol innun rekiin, keden mekarvin lah legabbeh, vearach bah kema deat amar, (Yeshayahu 11:3) vaharicho beyirat Adonai. kema dezammin malka meshicha lemebad bealma, veal yedeh abaru kullehu befikdona al yedeh, leitkarva lehala.

Vechullehu nishmatin kad itkerivu lehahu atar deitkerivu, veitchazun tamman, da ihu raza, kullehu nishmatin itkelilu behahi nekuda, venatla lon zimna chada, keman devala beliu demilla, veitabbera keitteta demitabbera. raza da lemare medin. kad hay nekuda itabberat, keitteta demitabbera, ithane mehahi hanauta, deitkelilat nishmeta mehay alma, beinnun ovadin, uvehahi orayyta deishtaddalat bah bimama. venatla hahu reu dehay alma, uveh ithane bechedva, veitkelilat mikkol sitrin.
Levatar appikat lon levar, veolidat lon kemillekaddemin, venishmeta ihi chadta hasheta kemillekadmin, veraza da (Eicha 3:23) chadashim labbekarim. chadashim vadday kema deittemar. ma taam
925: Innun chadashim. begin raza dichtiv, rabba emunatecha. rabba vadday, (Bereshit 19 amud bet) deyachla leachlela lon, uleaala lon legavvav, veappikat lon veinnun chadtin. veal da nakta acharanin milleella bimama. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay bealma den, uvealma deate.

Addehachi nahar yemama, amar ribbi abba, nekum unehach, venode leribbon alma. kamu veazlu, vetzalu, ulevatar ahadru chavrayyay legabbeh, amaru leh, man deshare, lesayyem shevacha. zakkaa chulakana beorcha da, dechol hay zachina leatera leh lekudesha berich hu, berazin dechachmeta.

Patach ribbi abba veamar, (Shemot 37:1) vayyaas betzalel et haaron atze shittim vegomer. hacha, af al gav dechol razin demashkena ha ukemuha chavrayyay beiddara kaddisha. hacha it leistakkela, deha raza da mitattera bechamma razin, lemelaf chachmeta. aron da ihu raza lemeal tora shebbichtav. veitgeniz beh beshit luchin (sefer acher vaatagenayzan beh shit luchin veinnun shit mesacharin) mesacharin, veda ikre aron. kad sacharan innun shit lemehve kachada, keden ihu gufa chad leaala beh raza deorayyta, beshit sitrin vaaron.

Luchin innun chamesh, vealin beh chamesh sefarim, veinnun chamesh innun shit, bechad darga deail bah bignizu, deikre raza decholla, vehay ihu raza divrit. kad al da, go innun chamesh luchin, keden kayyeyma arona veorayyta, beraza ditsha dargin, (213 amud alef) deinnun teren shemahan, Adonai elhim. ulevatar kayyeyma lucha chada, raza ilaa dechafya al cholla vehahu have raza dehahu rekia desachara vechafe al kolla vechullehu kayyme bignizu.

Hacha it lan leistakkela, uleminda razin daarona, it aron veit aron, da lokovel da. patach veamar, (Shmuel 2 24:23) hakkol natan aravna hammelech lammelech vegomer. vechi aravna melech hava veaf al gav dechavrayyay ukemuha, ella david, dichtiv beh (Shmuel 2 Adonai:8) kol makke yevusi veyyigga batztzinnor vegomer veihu natal vetafis liyrushala 40, umiddideh hava, amay kana bechaspa. vei tema af al gav dahavavt yerushalam dideh dedavid, hahu atar achasanteh daaravna hava, kema dehava benavot hayyizreeli, deaf al gav deshallit achav, vahava malka, itzterich lemitba lenavot hahu kerem, uf hachi david.

Ella vadday aravna malka hava, vehahu atar birshuteh hava, vahava shallit aloy, vechad mata zimna lenafka mittechot yedeh, la nafik ella bisgiut dama vekatola beyisrael. levatar kaim hahu malacha mechabbela al hahu atar, vetamman kad hava katil, vekaim behahu atar, la hava yachil, vetashash cheleh.

Vehahu atar, atar deitakad beh yitzchak hava, detamman bana avraham madbecha, veakad leh leyitzchak bereh. kevan dechama kudesha berich hu hahu atar, itmele rachamin, hada hu dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 21) raa Adonai vayyinnachem vegomer. mahu raa Adonai. chama akedat yitzchak behahu atar, vetav vericham alayyhu miyyad.

Vayyomer lammalach hammashchit rav atta vegomer. mahu rav. ha ukemuha, tol harav. ella hachi hu, ketiv hacha rav, uchetiv hatam, (Devarim 1:6) rav lachem shevet bahar hazze. uf hachi name rav, rav lach lemeheve hay atar techot yedach, shenin saggiin hava techot yedach, mikkan ulehala rav, ahadar atra lemareh. veim kol da (bidma) bemota umamona nafak mittechot yedeh.

Amay ikre aravna. ella ketiv aravna uchetiv arnan. beod dehahu atar hava techot yedeh, ikre aravna aron desitra achara. veal deittosafu beh atvavn yattir, hachi itzterich (164 amud bet) leittosfa lehahu ra ayin, raza desitra achara, vehahu tosefet ihu geriuta legabbeh.
Bistar kedushsha garin leh atvavn, veittosaf kedushateh. veda raza dichtiv, (Melachim 1 7:25) al shene asar bakar. gara mem
926: Dela ketiv shenayim, ella shene. ulesitra (164 amud bet) achara yahavin leh tosefet atvavn, dichtiv vayyaas yeriot izzim leohel al hammishkan ashte esre yeriot, tosefet atvavn veihu geriuta. uvesitra dikdushsha, sheni asar vela yattir. vehacha ashte esre. vecholla ihu geriu legabbeh, vehachi itzterich lehahu ra ayin, leashlema eneh veihu bigriu. (kegavvna da aravna, tosefet atvavn velo ketiv aron)

Ta chaze, sitra dikdushsha ikre aron habberit. vehahu aron habberit, itchaze legufa lemeal beh diyyukena deadam. veal raza da, innun chaside kaddishin, kad havo miftere mehay alma, havo alin lon bearon. deha sitra achara la mittakkan begufa, velav ihi bichlala degufa deadam. uvegin da la itberun gufayyay lehahu sitra achara, begin delav innun (hakedama 6 amud bet) bichlala degufa deadam.

Beyosef ma ketiv, (Bereshit 50:26) vayyishem baaron teren yodin amay. ella deitchabbar berit bivrit. raza diltatta beraza dilella. veal baarona. may taama. (sefer acher ta chaze sitra dikdushsha ikre aron habberit vehahu aron habberit ittakkan leaala beh raza deorayyta deihi raza dediyyukena degufa kaddisha. kegavvna da letatta ittakkan arona leaala beh diyyukena degufa raza deadam uman ihu dekaim beraza deadam man denatir et kayyeyma kaddisha veal raza da inun chaside kaddishin kad havo mapetarey mehay alma havo alin lon baarona begin dela itchaze lemeal baarona ella man denatir lehay berit et kayyeyma kaddisha. beyosef ma ketiv vayisem baaron) begin denatar berit kaddisha, veitkayyaym beh. lehachi itchaze leaala baarona, vecholla kadka chaze.

Bacha ribbi abba veamar, vavy livne alma, dela yade lehahu kissufa. vavy lehahu onsha, dechol man devae al baarona. begin dela itzterich lemeal baarona, bar tzaddik, deyada benafsheh, veishtemoda begarmeh, dela chata behahu berit, at kayyayma kaddisha, meulemoy, veka natir leh kadka yaut. vei lav, la itzterich leh lemeal baarona, ulemifgam arona.

Raza itzterich leitchabbera beat kayyayma kaddisha deihu raza deitchaze leh, vela leachara. deha aron la itchabbar ella betzaddik, denatir at kayyayma kaddisha. uman defagim berit veal baarona, vavy leh, defagim leh bechayyyoy. vavy leh defagim leh bemitateh. vavy leh mehahu onsha. vavy leh defagim at vearon kayyayma kaddisha. vavy leh lehahu kissufa, denakmin minneh nikmat almin, nukema dealma da, venukema dehahu pegimu. veraza da ketiv (Tehillim 125:3) ki lo yanuach shevet haresha al goral hatztzadikim.

Beshaata dedayynin leh behahu alma, mistakkelan beovadoy, i hava pagim raza divrit kaddisha dechatim bivsareh. vehasheta pagim arona (divrit) dileh behay. hay let leh chulaka betzaddikayyay. mistakkelin beh, vedayynin leh, umappeke leh levar mikkelala deadam. kevan deafke leh mikkelala deadam, afke leh mikkelala dechullehu acharanin, deitattedu lechayye alma, veyahave leh lehahu (aron) sitra dela itkelil beraza degufa deadam. kevan deittemsar lehahu sitra, vavy leh, deaalin leh begehinam, vela nafik minneh lealmin. al da ketiv (Yeshayahu 66:24) veyyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi vegomer. innun deishtaaru mikkelala deadam.

Vehane mile kad la aved tiuveta shelemata. tiuveta deihi itchazyay lechafyay al kol ovadoy. veim kol da tav leh dela yeul baarona, deha kol zimna degufa kayyaym, nishmeta itdenat, vela alat leatrah. bar innun chaside elyonin kaddishin, deitchazun lesalleka begufehon, zakkaa chulakehon bealma den uvealma deate.

Begin delet chova dekashya kammeh kudesha berich hu, kehay man dimshakker ufagim lehay at kayyayma kaddisha. veda la chame anpe shechinta, al chova da ketiv (Bereshit 38:7) vayhi er bechor yehuda ra beene Adonai. uchetiv (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) lo yegurecha ra.

Ma ketiv hacha, vayyaas betzalel et haaron. vechi amay la avdu innun chakkimin, deavdu mashkena, yat arona. ella betzalel, siyyuma degufa deihu (274 amud alef) raza divrit kaddisha, venatar leh, veihu kaim beadva dechulakeh. ihu ishtedal beovada dileh, vela achara. atu kullehu chavrayyay, venashsheku leh.
Kad matu legabbe deribbi shimon, vesadderu millin illen kammeh, kol ma deittemar behahu orcha. patach veamar, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga holech veor ad nechon hayyom.
927: Hay kera ittemar. aval hay kera it leistakkela beh, veorach tzaddikim, hahu orcha detzaddikayyay azlu beh, ihu orach keshot. orcha dekudesha berich hu itree beh. orcha deihu azil kamayyhu, vechol innun retichin, atyayn lemishma millin deinnun memallelan veamre befumayyhu. keor noga: denahir veazil, vela itchashach (sefer acher kelal), keorach deinnun chayyayvayya, deorach dilhon itchashach tadir, kema deat amer (Mishlei 4:19) derech reshaim kaafela vegomer.

Davar acher veorach tzaddikim. ma ben orach lederech, ha ukemuha. aval (137 amud alef Vayikra 88 amud alef) orach hu, dehashta itpetach veitgalyay, veitavid behahu atar orach, dela ketishu beh raglin mikkadmat dena. derech: kema deat amer (yeshaya 63) kedorech begat, dechatshin beh raglin kol man devae.

Veal da letzaddikayyay kare orach, deinnun havo kadmae lemiftach hahu atar. vela al atar ihu ella af al gav deacharanin bene alma azle behahu atar, hasheta deazlin beh tzaddikayyay, ihu atar chadta, dehashta chadta ihu hahu atar kema dela azil beh bar nash achara lealmin. begin detzaddikayyay avdin chadta lechol hahu atar, bechamma millin illain dekudesha berich hu itree behon.

Vetu, dishchinta azla behahu atar, ma dela havavt mikkadmat dena. ubbegin kach orach tzaddikim ikre, begin deitarach beh ushepiza illaa kaddisha. derech: ihu patuach lecholla, vechatshin beh kol man devae, afillu innun chayyayvin. derch, raza da, (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam darech, begin dedarich beh sitra achara, dela itzterich, veshalit lesaava mashkena. veal da, tzaddikayyay bilchodayyhu, kayyme veshalte behahu atar deikre orach. kema deokimna derech patuach lecholla, lehay sitra ulehay sitra.
Veattun kaddishe elyonin, orach kaddisha illaa izdaman legabbayychu, vearachtun beh umillin mealleyayn illain (nusach acher illen) itsaddaru kame attik yomin. zakkaa chulakechon.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Devarim la) vihoshua bin nun male ruach chachma ki samach moshe vegomer, bechamma atar tanenan, demoshe anpoy keanpe shimsha, vihoshua keanpe sihara. delet nehora lesihara, ella nehora deshimsha kad nahar lesihara, vesihara miggo shimsha itmalleyay. vechad itmalleyay, keden kayyeyma beashlemuta.

Ishtelimuta desihara, man ihu. raza decholla, deikre demut beraza dishma illaa Adonai. deha bishma da la kaim, bar bezimna dekayyeyma beashlemuta. deha kama shemahan innun deachasina, veitkere behu kach kefum shaata dekayyeyma beh, (uchefum shaata dekayyeyma beh) hachi ikre behahu shema mammash. vechad kayyeyma beraza deashlamuta veishtelimat mikkol sitrin, keden ikre Adonai ashlemuta dilah, keashlamuta dilella. (100 amud bet) deyarta berata leimmah.

Vehayeynu (davar acher nehiru) bachamesar yomin, dichtiv, (Vayikra 23:34) bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashshevii hazze. uchetiv (Vayikra 23:27) ach beasor (yom) lachodesh hashshevii. vecholla raza chada, kad kayyeyma alma deate beraza dechol eser amiran, al hay chodesh, ikre (185 amud bet) beasor. vechad itreshimat sihara beashlemuta chada benayyhu, ikre bachamishsha asar, deha Adonai itchabberat veitchakkat benayyhu.

Veraza da 15 vechad kayyeyma bishma da, keden itchabbar baAdonai, veihi itosfa (davar acher legabbeh tattae lemezan lon ulemehav lon tarpayyhu vaatavesapea) ihi, beraza deat Adonai kemillekadmin. chada, leitchakkeka uleitchabbera beraza dilella. vachada lemehav mezona letatta. ucheden kayyeyma sihara beashlemuta lechol sitrin, ella vetatta, beraza dishma da, lemeheve kolla raza chada, ushelimu chad.
Yehoshua da ihu raza deashlamuta desihara, beillen atvavn bin nun, nun vadday deha nun raza desihara ihi. male beraza deashlamuta dishma kaddisha, keden ihu male ruach chachma vadday.

Begin dinkuda illaa deihi 10, itpashat veappik ruach, vehahu ruach avid hechala. vehahu ruach itpashat, veitavid shit sitrin. hahu ruach itpashat, beraza dechol illen. veamle veavid hechala letatta, veitmelle kolla, veitavid raza
928: Uvegin da yehoshua male ruach chachma, begin ki samach moshe et yadav alav, deihu arik birchan aleh, veitmele bera minneh. veattun kaddishe elyonin, kol chad minnayychu itmele ruach chachma, vekayyeyma beashlemuta, berazin dechachmeta. begin dekudesha berich hu hu itree bechu, veasmich yedoy alayychu. zakkaa chulaki deenay chamu da, vechamu shelimu deruach chachmeta bechu.

Patach veamar, ketiv (Vayikra 19:26) lo tochlu al haddam lo tenachashu velo teonenu. hay kera ukemuha, veraza demilla, hay man deachil bela tzelota, ditzale (davar acher kodam deachil) al dameh, shakil ihu kimnachesh umeonen.

Begin divlelya nishmeta salkat veishtatchat lemechome beraza diykara illaa, kol chad vechad kema deitchaze leh. veishtear bar nash behahu chela deishtataf (nusach acher deitpeshat) go dama, leitkayyeyma gufa. veal da (sefer acher veim kol da) taim taama demota, vehahu chela la mitatteda leitteara go hahu chela denishmeta, ulekabbela leh. vechad itar bar nash, lav ihu dachi. veha okimna, desitra achara shallit, al atar dekayyeyma bela nishmeta.

Kevan deitdakke bemayya, veaf al gav deishtaddal bar nash beorayyta, (nusach acher taim tama demota, desitra achara shallit al atar dekayyeyma belo nishmeta vechad ittear bar nash af al gav deishtaddal beorayyta) hahi nishmeta la itkayyaymat beatrah, vela shalta beh bebar nash, bar chela dedama bilchodoy, deikre nefesh, hahi deitpashsheta bedama tadir, veha okimna. vechad yitzale bar nash tzelota defulechana demareh, keden mityayshsheva chela dedama beatreh, veitgabbar chela denishmeta, veityayshva al hahu atar. ucheden bar nash ishtelim kamme mareh, kema deitzterich, nefesh letatta, veraza demilla denishmeta leella.

Veal da, man detzalle tzelota ad la yechul, kaim garmeh kema deitzterich, vesalleka nishmeta al atar motva kema deitzterich, vei achil ad la tzale tzeloteh leityayshsheva dama al atreh, ha ihu kimnachesh umeonen. begin deha ihu archeh dimnachesh, lesalleka listar achara, ulemaacha sitra dikdushsha.

Amay ikre bar nash hahu deishtaddal behahu sitra menachesh. al deishtaddal behahu nachash, leattakfa cheleh uleitgabbera. veda ihu keman defalach lelohim acherim. vechen hay palach lehahu chela dedama, vela palach leh lekudesha berich hu, leattakfa sitra denishmeta, sitra dikdushsha.

Meonen, deishtaddal bechova, vela ishtaddal bizchu. vei tema ha kayyeyma 50 beemtzaita. hachi hu vadday, deha la yachlin leshalletaa behahu sitra achara, ad deitarve beh eruva distar kedushsha, kechuta chad dakik. man (hakedama 2 amud bet) devae lekayyeyma shikra, yearav bah milla dikshot, begin deyitkayyem hahu shikra. veal da avon milla desheker hu, uvegin lekayyeyma leh, alin bah milla dikshot, veda ihu 50, beda mekayyeyme lehahu sheker. uman dela tzale tzelota lekamme kudesha berich hu, ad la yechul al dameh, kimnachesh umeonen.

Tzelota devar nash, kema deamartun attun kaddishe elyonin, zakkaa chulakechon, deha bitzlota mitattekkan gufeh venafsheh devar nash, veitavid shelim. tzelota ihi tikkunin metakkenan demittakkenan kachada, veinnun arba. tikkuna kadmaa, tikkuna degarmeh, leishtallema. tikkuna tinyayna, tikkuna dehay alma. tikkuna telitaa, tikkuna dealma leella, bechol innun chele shemaya. tikkuna reviaa, tikkuna dishma kaddisha, beraza dirtichin kaddishin, uveraza dealmin kullehu, ella vetatta betikkuna (derazin dishma kaddisha) kedka yaut.

Tikkuna kadmaa tikkuna degarmeh, begin deitzterich leatkena garmeh, bemmitzva ukedushsha, uleittetakna bekarbenin veillavavn leitdakkaa. tikkuna tinyayna, betikkuna dekiyyuma dehay alma, beovada divreshit, levarcha lekudesha berich hu, al kol ovada veovada, beinnun haleluyah, (Tehillim 148:3-4) haleluhu kol kochve or haleluhu sheme hashshamayim vegomer lekayyeyma kiuma dehay alma. veal da bevaruch sheamar, baruch, baruch al kolla.
929: Lealma leella, bechol innun chayyayle chayyaylin umashiryayn. yotzer meshartim vaasher meshartav vegomer, vehaofannim vechayyot hakkodesh. tikkuna reviaa, tikkuna ditzlota, betikkuna deraza dishma kaddisha kadka amartun, zakkaa chulakechon. vehacha raza detikuna dishma shelim. zakkaa chulaki immechon behay alma uvealma deate.

Pikkude orayyta (202 amud bet) deamartun bitzlota vadday hachi hu. patach veamar, ketiv (Devarim 10:20) et Adonai elohecha tira oto taavod. uchetiv, (Vayikra 19:14) veyareta meelohecha. hay kera it lememar hachi, veyareta elohecha, begin deha ketiv et Adonai elohecha tira, mahu meelohecha. ella raza ihu, meelohecha vadday, mehahu atar deitchabbar vesachara lemocha dilgo, veda ihu meelohecha, dechilu da lemidchal leh, deha tamman sharyay dina, veihu dina deishteiv miggo dina dilella, behay atar.

(It eshsha veit eshsha) telat gevavne eshsha hacha. eshsha kadmaa, ihu eshsha dekabbil eshsha bechedu, vechaddan da beda birchimu. eshsha tinyayna, ihu eshsha dichtiv beh (Yechezkel 1:13) venoga laesh deitchaze beh noga. veda ihu eshsha, dekayyeyma go eshsha penimaa bechedu, kema (203 amud bet) deittemar. eshsha telitaa, ihu eshsha (dilvar) desachara lehahu noga. uvehay eshsha shari dechilu dedina, lealkaa chayyayvayya.
Veaf al gav detanenan, dearbaa gevavni eshsha ninhu, veinnun arba deinnun chad. aval hacha behahu eshsha dekaamran, shaari dechilu dedina, veal da ketiv, veyareta meelohecha, mehahu onsha dileh.

Uvehahu yira bae leshavvava reuteh, bidchilu urechimu kachada, lemidchal behay sitra, ulemircham behay sitra. uveinnun gavvnin dekaamran, vehahu dechilu lehve lemidchal meonsha. deman deavar al pikkude orayyta, itannash behahu sitra dechad shari hahu sitra lealkaa, la shachich ad deshatze leh mehay alma, umealma deate. ubbegin kach bae lemidchal mehay eshsha, didchilu sharyay beh.

Uminneh itpashat eshsha levar dedachala achara, veal da ketiv, (Shoftim 6:10) lo tirau et elohe haemori, deasir lemidchal minneh. vehay eshsha didchilu dekaamran, ihu kodesh veishtattaf bikdushsha, vehay ihu desachara lehahu noga dekaamran. vehahi eshsha achara dilvar, ihu deitchabbar behay lezimnin. ulezimnin itabbar minneh, vela itchabbar bahadeh. vechad garim deitchabbar behay, keden hu eshsha dechashuch, veachshich vechasse nehiru deillen acharanin. vesimanich (Yechezkel 1:4) veesh mitlakkachat, vela dekayyeyma tadir, veha ittemar

Levatar ahava, kema deukemuha deahava sharyay levatar yira. veraza demilla, kevan deshari yira al resheh devar nash, ittear levatar ahava, deihu yemina. deman defalach miggo ahava, itdabbak baatar illaa leella, veitdabbak bikdushsha dealma deate, begin deha salik leitattera uleitdabbeka bistar yemina.

Vei tema defulechana deihu missitra deyira lav ihu pulechana. pulechana yakkira ihu, aval la salik leitdabbeka leella. vechad palach meahava, salik veitattar leella, veitdabbak bealma deate, veda ihu bar nash deizdaman lealma deate, zakkaa chulakeh deha shalit al atar deyira, deha let man deshallit al darga deyira, ella ahava, raza dimina.

Raza deyichuda deitzterich leh lehahu deitchaze lealma deate, leyachada shema dekudesha berich hu, uleyaychada shayyfin vedargin illain vetattain, leachlela kullehu, ulealaa baatar deitzterich lekashshera kishra. veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad.

Veraza (160 amud bet) dishma, shem desalik le shemahan, veda kelala chada. yisrael: yisrael sava, begin deit (43 amud alef) zuta, dichtiv (Hoshea 11:1) naar yisrael vaohavehu. veda ihu yisrael sava, raza chada bichlala chada. shema yisrael, hacha itkelilat itteta bevalah.
Ulevatar deitkelilu da beda bichlala chada, keden itzterichu leyaychada
930: Shayyfin, ulechavra teren mashkenin kachada, bechullehu shayyfin, biru delibba, leistalleka bidvekuta deen sof, leitdabbeka kolla tamman, lemeheve reuta chada illae vetattae.

Veraza da yihye, kema deat amer (Zecharya 14) yihye Adonai echad, beraza deyihye. 10, leyachada uleitdabbeka baAdonai, deihu hechala penimaa, leatar (nusach acher atar) genizu dehay nekuda illaa, deihi 10. veda ihu raza Adonai elohenu. illen teren atvavn (nusach acher shemahan) deinnun ya.
Uleachlela kol shayyfin behahu atar denafku minneh, deihu hechala penimaa, leatva millin leatrehon, leikara visoda vesharsha dilhon, ad hahu atar desharsha divrit.

Ulevatar innun teren atvavn acharanin (deihu 15) leyachada uleitdabbeka 10 baAdonai. 10 ihu raza divrit kaddisha. vehay Adonai ihu hechala, atar genizu dehay raza divrit kaddisha deihu 10. veaf al gav deokimna deihu 6 tinyayna. aval 10, raza dileh leyachada lon kachada.

Echad, leyachada mittamman uleella, kolla kachada, ulesalleka reuta leitkashshera kolla (mittatta leella) bekishshura chad. lesalleka reuteh bidchilu urechimu leella leella ad en sof vela yishtevak reuta mikkol innun dargin veshayyfin, ella bechullehu yistelak reuteh leadbeka lon, ulemeheve kolla kishshura chada been sof.

Veda hu yichuda derav hamenuna sava, deolif meavoy, vaavoy merabbeh, ad puma deeliyyahu, veshappir ihu, veyichuda betikkuna. veaf al gav deanan okimna lehay bechamma razin, kullehu razin sallekin lechad. aval raza da ashkachna besifreh, veshappir ihu, veyichuda betikkuna. veha anan beyichuda deraza achara ittearna millin, veihu shappir, veyichuda kadka chaze vehachi hu. aval yichuda da, yichuda betikkuna, veda ihu yichuda derav hamenuna sava.

Vetu hava amar, man diruteh leachlela kol razin deyichuda bemilla deechad shappir tefe. ulehachi anan maarichin beechad, lesalleka reuteh meella letatta, umittatta leella, lemehve kolla chad. aval beraza da yihye, simana (bealma) ihu lehay.

Veha detanenan echad (lemeheve 4) raza ella vetatta, vearba sitrin dealma, hachi ihu. leyachada ella vetatta kema deittemar (sefer acher ulearba) vearba sitrin dealma, illen innun raza reticha illaa, leitkallela kolla kachada, bekishra chada, beyichuda chada ad en sof, kema deokimna.

Raza leadkera yetziat mitzrayim levatar. begin dahavavt shechinta begaluta, uvezimna deihi begaluta, lav ihu chibbura, leitchabbera da beda alma tattaa bealma illaa, uleachazaa cheru dehahi geula, dahavavt bechamma atin, bechamma nissin deavad kudesha berich hu. veitzterich hahu purekana leitdakkera, uleitchazaa deaf al gav dahavavt begaluta, hasheta cheru it lah, miyyoma deinnun kishrin bemitzrayim ishteriu, innun atin venissin itavidu.

Veitztericha leachazaa cheru dilah, begin deitchabbera bevalah uvegin leasmecha geula litfilla, lemehve kolla chad bela piruda, vela leachazaa tiruchin, vesimanich (Vayikra 21:7) veishsha gerusha meishah lo yikchu.

Vei tema, veha begaluta ihi, veha ittarchat, lav hachi, ella vadday begaluta ihi, ledayyeyra immehon deyisrael, uleaggana alayyhu, aval la ittarchat. veha shechinta la itchaze bevayit rishon uvevet sheni. ad dela galu yisrael salleka leella, ulevatar ihi shaviat madora immehon. aval tiruchin la havavt lealmin.

Uvegin da bae leachazaa purekana, deit ba arba geulot. veraza hacha, beshaata denafka shechinta miggaluta demitzrayim, tavat mekkudesha berich hu, deyifrok lah hasheta 4 zimnin, deinnun 4 geulot, lokovel arba galuyot. begin dethe bat chorin, vela tehe mittarcha. uvehahi shaata kayyeyma veitparkat arba geulot, behahi yetziat mitzrayim. vehasheta deitzterichat betikkunaha leitchabbera bevalah, itzterich leachazaa hahi geulat mitzrayim, deit ba arba geulot.
931: Leadkera behahi geula, 4 zimnin emet. emet. emet. emet. ad ezrat avotenu. deda hu ezra vesemech leyisrael kullehu. umittamman ulehala arba zimnin acharanin, emet, emet, emet, emet. lemeheve arba geulot illen bekiyyuma takkif, bechotama takkif degushepanka demalka. 4 geulot kefulin bekiyyuma.

Vechullehu behahi yetziat mitzrayim, deillu la ishtechachu innun 4 geulot behahi yetziat mitzrayim, kol zimna delihve galuta, la itchabberat betikkunaha leityaychada shema kaddisha. veal da it leadkera geula demitzrayim tadir, vechol kiddushin dekudesha berich hu, berich shemeh lealam ulealme almayyay.

Raza dikdushsha (dishmeh) ha okimna, deha bikdushsha mitkaddeshe kolla, ella vetatta, vechol dargin, vechol retichin illain vetattain, kullehu mitkaddeshe bikdushata da. uvikdushsha da, okimna razin illain, leinnun mare razin demistakkelin bikdushsha demarehon, zakkaa chulakehon.

Raza lemimsar nafsha lemareh, shappir ihu, deka (Rabbi amud bet) amartun chavrayyay, zakkaa chulakechon, vezakkain enay dechamu kach, dezachena bechayye, demitarin millin kaddishin illen behay alma, (sefer acher begin dechullehu) vechullehu ketive leella kame malka kaddisha.

Patach veamar (Malachi 3:16) az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma vayyikkatev sefer zikkaron lefanav leyire Adonai ulechoshve shemo. hay kera it leistakkela beh, az nidberu, az dibberu mibbae leh, may nidberu. ella nidberu leella, mikkol innun retichin kaddishin, vechol innun chayyaylin kaddishin.

Begin deinnun millin kaddishin, sallekin leella, vechamma innun dimkaddeme venatlin lon kamme malka kaddisha, umitatteran bechamma itrin, beinnun nehorin illain, vechullehu nidberu mikkamme malka illaa. man chame chedvavn, man chame tushebchan, desallekin vechol innun rekiin, kad sallekin millin illen, umalka kaddisha mistakkal behu, veitattar behu, veinnun sallekin (nusach acher al resheh dahavo atara venachtin veyatvin vechulei) veyatvin al chekeh, umishtaasha behu, mittamman sallekin al resheh, vahavu atara. veal da amra orayyta, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye shaashuim yom yom. vehayiti la ketiv, ella vaehye, vechol zeman, uvechol iddan, demillin illain sallekin kammeh.

Tere zimne ketiv yire Adonai yire Adonai. ella yire Adonai leella, yire Adonai letatta. yire Adonai kayymin letatta, veinnun millin kayymin bediyyukenehon leella. veraza da ashkachna besifra dechanoch, dechol millin detzaddikayyay di beara, innun mitatteran, vekayyman kamme malka, umishtaasha behu kudesha berich hu. ulevatar innun nachte, vekayymin kammeh bediyyukena dehahu tzaddik dekaamar lon, veishtaasha kudesha berich hu behahu diyyukena. ulevatar achtivu besefer zikkaron lefanav, lekayyeyma kammeh bekiyyuma tadir.

Ulechoshve shemo, may ulechoshve shemo. ha ukemuha, (aval) kol innun dimchashsheve millin deorayyta, leadbeka lemarehon beraza dishma kaddisha, begin leminda leh, uleittakna chachma dishmeh belibbayyhu, dichtiv ulechoshve shemo, dehu raza dishma kaddisha.

Ketiv (Yechezkel 1:26) umimmaal larakia asher al rosham kemare even sappir demut kisse, hay kera ha ukemuha. aval umimmaal larakia, behahu rakia letatta, kema deamartun chavrayyay, zakkaa chulaki, vezakkaa chulakechon. (behahu rakia letatta) deha birkia dilella, let man deistakkal beh. umilleella minneh kayyeyma hahu even sappir, deha ittearna beh beraza dehahu margalit tava yakkira, kema deokimna.

Demut kisse, vela ketiv demut hakkisse. begin deit kisse, veit kisse. hakkisse: illaa temira geniza dela itgalyay, velet man dekayyeyma beh leminda uleistakkela. veal da ketiv kisse setama, da kisse diltatta.

Demut kemare adam, kevan deamar demut, amay kemare, deha saggi leh demut adam. ella demut adam, da ihu raza illaa, behahu kavod illaa, diyyukena deadam. aval ha deittosaf kemare, leachlela innun diukenin demillin dechachmeta, veinnun razin dechachmeta
932: Desalkan umitatteran leella, ulevatar kayymin bediyyukena deadam behahu diyyukena detzaddikayyay dimatterin lon, uvechullehu ishtasha kudesha berich hu beitroy.

Veattun chavrayyay, ha kudesha berich hu ishtasha hasheta, beinnun millin deka amrittu, mitatteran behahu orcha. veha keyyaymtun kamme marechon bediyyukenayychu kaddishin, deha ana beshaata dachamena lechu, veistakkalna bediyyukenayychu, chamena bechu deattun reshimin beraza deadam, veyadana deha diyyukena dilchon itatteda leella. vehachi izdammenan tzaddikayyay lezimna deate, leishtemoda leenehon decholla, uleachazaa partzufa kaddisha lekame kol alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 61:9) kol roehem yakkirum ki hem zera berach Adonai.

Addehachi chama leribbi yose, dehava mehareher bemille dealma. amar leh, yose kum ashlim diyyukenach, deat chad chaser bach. kam ribbi yose vechadde bemillin deorayyta, vekam kammeh, istakkal beh rabbi shimon, amar leh, ribbi yose, hasheta ant shelim kamme attik yomin, vediyyukenach shelim.

Patach veamar, (Shemot 28:14) vayyaas et tzitz nezer hakkodesh zahav tahor vegomer. amay ikre tzitz. istakkeluta leistakkela beh. uvegin dehava kayyeyma al istakkeluta devar nash, ikre tzitz. vechol man deistakkal beh behahu tzitz ishtemoda beh.

Batzitz havo atvavn dishma kaddisha gelifan begillufa, umechakkekan beh. vei zakkaa hava hahu dekayyeyma kammeh, innun atvavn dimchakkekan beh go dahava, havo baltin mittatta leella, vesallekin mehahu gelifu binhiru, vahavu naharin beanpin dehahu bar nash.

Natzitz netzitzu beh, vela natztzin. beshaata kadmita deistakkal kahana beh, hava chame nehiru deatvavn kullehu beanpin. vechad hava mistachlla leayyna beh, la hava chame midi, ella nehiru deanpoy denahir, keillu nitzotza dedahava hava natzitz beh, bar dechahana hava yada chezu deistakkeluta kadmaa, dehava chame lefum shaata, deha reuta dekudesha berich hu hava beh behahu bar nash, veyada deihu zammin lealma deate, begin dechezu da naharin aleh milleella, vekudesha berich hu hava itree beh. vechad mistakkelin beh la chaman midi, begin dechezu dilella la itgalyay ella lefum shaata.
Vei kayyeyma bar nash kamme hahu tzitz, veanpoy la itchazyayn lefum shaata, chezu kaddisha. hava yada kahana deha ihu takkif mitzcha, uvae lechappera aleh, ulemibbae aloy rachamin.

(Shemot 40) vayyaas et tzitz nezer hakkodesh. ribbi yehuda patach kera berut, (Rut 2:9) enayich bassade asher yiktzorun vegomer. hay kera it leistakkela beh, amay itzterich hacha lemichtav. amar leh ribbi yitzchak, i hachi kamma kerain innun beorayyta deitchaziu dela itzterichu lemichtav, vechamenan dechullehu razin illain. amar ribbi yehuda, hay kera man dechame vela istakkal beh, kema dela taim tavshila dame.

Ella raza hacha, uveruach kudesha ittemar, begin dechama boaz dayyayna deyisrael, anvavtanuta dehahi tzaddeket, dela mesalleka ena lemechome baatar achara, ella lekammah. vechamat kol ma dechamat, beena tava, vetukepa demitzcha la hava ba, shibbach enaha.

Begin deit ayynin divginehon la shalta birchata behahu atar, veihu ena tava chama ba, dechol ma deistakkelat hava beena tava. vetu, dechama, dehava atzlach bidaha, kol ma dahavavt lakta, ittosaf bechakla. uvoaz istakkal derucha kaddisha sharyay alah, keden patach veamar, enayich bassade asher yiktzorun vegomer. i tema begin innun laktin chol innun acharanin, hech amar detehach avatrayyhu, la itzterich lemichtav ella velakatt acharehen, may vehalacht acharehen, ella begin enaha kaamar. enaha dahavo garmin (nusach acher birchan saggiin, veal da vechulei), birchata laktin saggiin veal da vehalacht acharehen, batar enayich. kol shear beni alma let lehu
933: Reshu lemehach batar enoy. veant levatar enayich, deenayich garmin birchan saggiin.

Davar acher enayich bassade asher yiktzorun. boaz chama beruach kudesha, dizminin lenafka minnah malchin illain shallitin deinnun ayynin decholla. kema dahavavt tamar, dichtiv bah, (Bereshit 38:14) vatteshev befetach enayim. ityayshshevat befitcha denafkin minnah malchin shallitin illain, deikrun ayynin, kema deat amer (Bamidbar 15:24) im meene haeda. kema dechol shayyfe gufa la azlin ella batar ayynin, veayynin innun minhagin lechol gufa. uf hachi malchin vesanhedrin, vechol innun shallitin, kolla azlin avatrayyhu (sefer acher deazlin shayyfin batar ayynin) uvegin kach amar lah enayich illen malchin veshallitin, dizminin lemefak minnah.

Bassade. man sade. da tziyyon viyrushala 40, dichtiv, (Micha 3:12) tziyyon sade techaresh. uchetiv (Bereshit 27:27) keriach sade asher beracho Adonai, da yerushala 40. veal da ketiv enayich bassade, deinnun ayynin dilah, dizminin lemefak minnah, la yehon shallitin ella bassade. asher yiktzorun, deha mehahu sade, havo naktin kol bene alma tora, unehora denahir, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:3) ki mitztziyyon tetze tora.

Vehalacht acharehen, beillen ovadin dechashran, daana chamena becha. halo tzivviti et hannearim vegomer. kemashmao dileh, begin deitteta data kala. vetzamit, lishana dinkiut nakat, vetzamit, dei tiuvetich leadbeka bevar nash lekayyeyma zara bealma, vehalacht el hakkelim, illen innun tzaddikayyay, deikrun kele Adonai, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 52:11) hibbaru nose kele Adonai. dizminin tzaddikayyay leayytaa lon kol alma, dorona lemalka meshicha, veinnun kele Adonai, manin dekudesha berich hu ithane behu, illen innun manin tevirin, tevirin innun behay alma, begin lekayyeyma orayyta. veshimusha dekudesha berich hu ishtemmash behu, la ishtammash ella miggo hane kelim. vechad titdevak behu veshatita vegomer.

Ribbi yose patach veamar, (Rut 3:7) vayochal boaz vayyesht vayyitav libbo. mahu vayyitav libbo. devarich al mezoneh, veukemuha. veda hu raza, deman dimvarech al mezoneh, da otiv lelibbeh, uman otiv (nusach acher ihu) kema dichtiv, (tehillim 27 8) lecha amar libbi. uchetiv (Tehillim 73:26) tzur levavi vegomer.

Uvegin devirkat mezona chaviva kamme kudesha berich hu, kol man devarich al sava, otiv vechadde laatar achara, vesimanich seudate deshabbat, deatar achara ithani mehahi beracha (204 amud bet) desava vechidu. vehacha ithane mehahu beracha desava dehahu tzaddik boaz veda vayyitav libbo.

May tama. begin dimzona ihu kashe kamme kudesha berich hu hahu atar, vechevan devar nash achil veshate, veka mevarech. hahi birchata salleka, veithane meinnun millin desava desalkin, veishtechach deithane mimmezona mittatta umilleella.

Veda ihu raza deven chavrayyay. raza bechol la ithane hahu atar, ella meinnun millin desalkin miggo sava, vechullehu millin mitatteran veravvavn vesavin bechedu, vehahu atar ithani minnayyhu. beshabbat ihu raza ochora, bimzona mammash, uvehahu chedva dimzona demitzva deshabbat, uvecholla ishtechach kelila meella vetatta. veraza da (divrei hayamim 1 29 14) ki mimmecha hakkol umiyyadcha natannu lach. vadday bahanauteh da, uvehahu chedva dimzona demitzva deshabbat, kema deukemuha.

Man dimvarech lekudesha berich hu miggo sava, bae lechavvevna libbeh, uleshavvava reuteh bechedva, vela yishtekach atziv, ella divarech bechedva beraza da, uleshavvaa reuteh deha ihu yahiv hasheta leachara bechedva, beena tava, uchemma deihu mevarech bechedva uvaena tava. hachi yahavin leh bechedva uvaena tava. ubbegin kach la yishtekach atziv kelal, ella bechedva, uvemillin deorayyta, vishavve libbeh ureuteh lemehav beracha da, beraza deitzterich.

Raza hacha, arba retichin shallitin, bed sitrin umashiryayn, itzanu mehahi birchata desava, uveinnun millin devaruch atta, ithani veitrabbe veitattar beh. uman dimvarech itzterich reuta bechedva, uveena tava, veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 22:9) tov ayin hu yevorach.
Vehacha shafil lesefeh dikra, dichtiv ki natan millachmo laddal. dei la tema hachi, hay kera lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh. ella tov
934: Ayin, kema deokimna, hu yevarech vadday, beena tava bechedva. velav ihu lemigna levarcha bechedva, deha mehahi birchata, umehahu chedu natan millachmo laddal, atar deitzterich leitzana mikkol sitrin. atar delet leh miggarmeh kelum. atar deithani mikkol sitrin veitkelil mikkol sitrin. millin illen la itmesaru ella lechakkimin deyadin razin illain veorchin deorayyta.

Ta chaze, boaz tav ena hava tukepa demitzcha la hava beh lealma. ma ketiv, (Rut 3:7) vayyavo lishkav biktze haarema, raza dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:3) bitnech aremat chittim. mehacha olifna, kol man dimvarech birkat mezona kedka yeot, bechedva biruta delibba, kad salik mehay alma, atar ittakna leh, go razin illain behechalin kaddishin. zakkaa ihu bar nash denatir pikkude demareh, veyada raza dilhon, delet lach pikkuda ufikkuda beorayyta, dela talyayn beh razin illain, unehorin vezivin illain, uvene nasha la yade, vela mashgichin bikara demarehon. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, innun demishtaddele beorayyta zakkain innun bealma den uvealma deate.

Ta chaze deha amru, dechol innun takife mitzcha, delet lehu kissufa, let lehon chulaka bealma den uvealma deate. kol innun takife mitzcha dahavo behu beyisrael, kad havo mistakkelan behahu tzitz, havo mitavran libbayyhu, umistakkelan beovadayyhu. begin detzitz al at hava kaim, vechol man demistakkel beh, hava machsif beovadoy. veal da tzitz mechappera al innun takife anpin, takife mitzcha.

Atvavn deraza dishma kaddisha dahavo gelifin al tzitza, havo naharin uvaltin venatztzin. kol man dehava mistakkal behahu netzitzu deatvavn, anpoy naflin meemata, vahava itbar libbeh, ucheden tzitza mechappera alayyhu. kegavvna da kevan deihu garim letavra libbeh, uleitkannea mikkamme mareh.

Kegavvna da ketoret, kol man dearach behahu tenana, kad salik hahu ammuda mehahu maale ashan, hava mevarer libbeh, bivriru binhiru bechedva lemiflach lemareh, veabar minneh zuhama deyetzer hara, vela hava leh ella libba chada, lokovel avuha devishmayya. begin diktoret, teviru deyetzer hara ihu vadday bechol sitrin. uchemma detzitz hava kaim al nisa, uf ketoret. delet lach milla bealma, lemitbar leh lesitra achara, bar ketoret.

Ta chaze ma ketiv, (Bamidbar 17:11) kach et hammachta veten aleha esh meal hammizbeach vesim ketoret. may tama. ki yatza hakketzef millifne Adonai, hechel hannagef. deha let teviru lehahu sitra bar ketoret. delet lach milla chaviva kame kudesha berich hu, kiktoret. vekayyeyma levattela charshin, umillin bishin mibbeta. recha vaashana diktoret deavde beni nasha, behahu ovda ihu mevattel, kol shekken ketoret.

Milla da gezera kayyeyma kamme kudesha berich hu, dechol man deistakkal vekare bechol yoma ovda (nusach acher parsheta) diktoret, yishteziv mikkol millin bishin charshin dealma. umikkol pegain bishin, umehirhura bisha, umiddina bisha, umimotana, vela yitzak kol hahu yoma, dela yachil sitra achara leshalta aleh, veitzterich dichavven beh.

Amar rabbi shimon, i bene nasha havo yade kama illaa ihu ovada diktoret kamme kudesha berich hu, havo natle kol milla umilla minneh, vahavu salke le atara al reshayyhu, kechitra dedahava. uman deishtaddal beh, bae leistakkela beovada diktoret, vei yechaven beh bechol yoma, it leh chulaka behay alma, uvealma deate, veyistallak motana minneh, umealma, veyishteziv mikkol dinin dehay alma, missitrin bishin, umiddina degehinnam, umiddina demalchu achara.
Behahu ketoret kad hava salik tenana beammuda, kahana hava chame atvavn deraza dishma
935: Kaddisha, perisa (nusach acher parchin) baavira, vesalke leella behahu ammuda. levatar kama retichin kaddishin sacharin leh mikkol sitrin, ad desalik binhiru vechedva, vechadde leman dechadde, vekashar kishrin leella vetatta leyachada kolla, veha okimna. veda mechapper al yetzer hara, veal avoda zara, deihu sitra achara. veha okmuha.

Patach veamar, (Shemot 37) vayyaas mizbeach miktar ketoret vegomer. hay kera it leistakkela beh, begin ditren madbechin havo, madbecha deillavavn, umadbecha diktoret busemin, da levar, veda lego. hay madbecha diktoret, deihu penimaa, amay ikre mizbeach, veha la davchin beh divchin, umizbeach al da ikre.

Ella begin devatil vechafit lechamma sitrin bishin, uvegin dehahu sitra bisha kefit la yachil leshalletaa, vela lemeheve kattegora, veal da ikre mizbeach. kad hahu sitra bisha hava chame (sefer acher ammuda deushna) ashana diktoret desalik, itkafyay vearak, vela yachil lekarva kelal lemashkena. uvegin da itdache vela itarav behahu chedva dilella, bar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, uvegin dechaviva kol kach, la kaim hahu mizbeach, ella (davar acher penimaa) lego. dehay ihu mizbeach devirkan ishtechachu beh, veal da satim meena.

Ma ketiv beaharon, (Bamidbar 17:13) vayyaamod ben hammetim uven hachayyim vatteatzar hammaggefa, dechafit leh lemalach hammavet, dela yachil leshalletaa kelal, vela lemebad dina. simana da itmesar bidana, di bechol atar dekaamre bechavavna, ureuta delibba ovada diktoret, dela shalta motana behahu atar, vela yitzak, vela yachlin shear ammin leshalletaa al hahu atar.

Ta chaze ma ketiv, mizbeach miktar ketoret. kevan dichtiv mizbeach, amay ikre miktar ketoret. ella begin denatle mehay atar leaktera, kema deavad aharon. tu, mizbeach itzterich leaktera lekaddesha leh behahu ketoret, veal da miktar ketoret. tu, miktar ketoret, ketargumo, leaktera ketoret, deha asir leaktera baatar achara ketoret, bar mimmachta. (nusach acher mimmechitta deyom hakkippurim)

Ta chaze, hay man dedina radif avatreh, itzterich lehay ketoret, uleatava kamme mareh, deha siyyua ihu leistalleka dinin minneh, uvehay vadday mistallekin minneh, i hu ragil behay, leadkera teren zimnin beyoma, betzafra uveramsha, dichtiv ketoret sammim babboker vabboker uchetiv ben haarbayim yaktirenna. veda ihu kiuma dealma tadir, dichtiv, (Shemot 30:8) ketoret tamid lifni Adonai ledorotechem vadday hu kiuma dealma letatta, vekiyyuma dealma leella.

Behahu atar dela idkar bechol yoma ovada diktoret, dinin dilella sharyayn beh, umotanin sagiu beh, veammin acharanin shaltin aleh. begin dichtiv, ketoret tamid lifne Adonai. tamid ihu kayyeyma lifne Adonai, yattir mikkol pulechanin acharanin, chaviva ihu ovada diktoret, dehu yakkir vechaviv kamme kudesha berich hu, yattir mikkol pulechanin ureutin (nusach acher veovadin) dealma. veaf al gav ditzlota ihi mealleyay mikkolla, ovada diktoret hu yakkir vechaviv kame kudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, ma ben tzelota leovada diktoret. tzelota atkinu lah baatar dekarbenin, dahavo avde yisrael, vechol innun karbenin dahavo avdin yisrael, lav innun chashivin kiktoret. vetu ma ben hay lehay. ella tzelota ihu tikkuna leatkena ma deitzterich, ketoret avid yattir, metakken vekashir kishrin, veavid nehiru yattir mikkolla. uman ihu deabar zuhama veidke mashkena, vecholla itnehir veittakkan veitkashshar kachada.
Veal da baenan leakdema ovada diktoret litzlota, bechol yoma veyoma, leabera zuhama mealma, deihu tikkuna decholla, bechol yoma veyoma. kegavvna dehahu karbana chaviva deitree beh kudesha berich hu.

Ma ketiv bemoshe (shamevatel) vayyomer Adonai el moshe kach lecha sammim nataf vegomer af al gav deokmuha, aval may shena beovada da yattir mikkol ma deamar leh. ella kach lecha, lahanaatach uletoaltach. begin dechad itteta itdakkeat, hanauta devalah ihu. veraza da kach lecha sammim, leabera zuhama, leitkaddesha itteta bevalah. zakkaa chulakeh
936: Kegavvna da (Vayikra 9:2) kach lecha egel ben bakar, deittemar leaharon. lechappara al choveh, al hahu egel deihu garim lon leyisrael. veal da ketiv bemoshe, kach lecha, lahanaatach, uletoaltach. (sefer acher lechach ukemuha bappasel lecha, mehahu pesolet dalevach avna nitashsher moshe uf hachi lecha lahanaatach uletovatcha)

Ketoret kashir keshiru, nahir nehiru veabar zuhama. ved itchabbar baAdonai (davar acher 4 itavid Adonai), Adonai itchabbar bev. 6 salik veitattar baAdonai. Adonai itnehir bey. vecholla salik reuta leen sof. vahave kolla keshiru chad, veitavid chad keshiru, beraza chada deihu kishra illaa decholla.

Mikkan ulehala, kevan decholla itkashshera behay kishra, itattar kolla beraza deen sof. veraza dishma kaddisha itnehir, veitattar bechol sitrin, vealmin kullehu bechedva. veitnehiru butzinin umezonin uvirkan ishtechachu bechol almin, vecholla beraza diktoret. vei zuhama la itabbar, kolla la itavid. decholla behay talyay.

Ta chaze, ketoret ihu kadmaa tadir, kodam lecholla. ubbegin kach ovada diktoret itzterich leakdema litzlota, leshirin vetushebchan. begin dechol da la salleka, vela ittakkan, vela itkashshar, ad deitavar zuhama, ma ketiv (Vayikra 16:16) vechipper al hakkodesh vegomer bekadmita, ulevatar umippishehem lechol chattotam. veal da baenan lechappera al kudesha, uleabera zuhama, uleitdakkea kudsha. ulevatar shirin vetushebchan utzelotin, kolla kidkaamran.

Zakkain innun yisrael bealma den, uvealma deate, deha innun yadin letakkena tikkuna dilella vetatta, kidvaenan letakkena tikkuna mittatta leella ad deitkashshar kolla kachada, bekishshura chad, behahu kitura (sefer acher kishshura) illaa kad baenan letakkena (tikkunin letatta bainan letakkena) betikkuna deatvavn reshimin, dekudesha berich hu itkere behon.

Rabbi shimon veribbi elazar bereh, havo yatve lelya chad, velaan beorayyta. amar ribbi elazar lerabbi shimon avoy. ha ketiv (Bereshit 3:16) veel haishsha amar hareba arbe itztzevonich veheronich beetzev teldi vanim veel ishech teshukatech vegomer. veolifna deda ihu raza illaa. tinach letatta, aval ihu kegavvna dilella, may ikka lememar.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Tehillim 42:2) keayyal taarog al afike mayim vegomer. hay kera ukemuha. aval chayya chada it bealma, veihi shalta beshultana al elef maftechan bechol yoma. veihi nukeba vetiuveta dilah tadir al afike mayim lemishte uleitravava mitzachuta, dichtiv keayyal taarog al afike mayim.

Hacha it leistakkela. bekadmita ketiv keayyal, vela ketiv kaayyelet, ulevatar taarog, vela ketiv yaarog. aval raza da, dechar venukeba tarvavyyhu kachada dela leafrasha lon, vechad ihu, dela itzterich lesalleka da min da, ella tarvavyyhu kachada. vehay nukeba, taarog al afike mayim, veihi mitabbera min dechura, vekashe alah deha al dina kayyeyma.

Vechad olidat kudesha berich hu zammin lah chad chivya illaa ravreva, veate venashich legabbe hahu atar, veolidat. veraza da hareba arbe itztzevonech veheronech, begin deihi mitchalchela bechol yoma, uveatztzivu al ovadin dealma. beetzev teldi vanim. beetzev, da raza dechivyay, deatziv anpehon dealma.

Veel ishech teshukatech, kema deat amer taarog al afike mayim. vehu yimshal bach, ha okimna raza, deihu shallit alah. vechol da lamma. begin deamra sihara, kema detanenan. ubbegin kach azirat nehoraa, veazirat shuletanaha, velet lah reshu miggarmah, bar kad yahavin lah chela.

Beetzev teldi banim, kema deokimna. vei tema amay itzterich chivya leda. ella da patach orcha lenachta kol (sefer acher bechol) innun nishmatin dealma. deilmale la patach orchin lenachta letatta, la yishre begaveh devar nash, ma ketiv lappetach chattat rovetz. may lappetach. lehahu petach deitatteda leolada, leappaka nishmatin lealma, ihu kaim legabbe hahu petach.

Vechol innun nishmatin deitzterichu lenachta begufin kaddishin, la kaim ihu lehahu petach, velet leh reshu behahi nishmeta. vei lav, ha chivya nashich, veisteav hahu nahar (sefer acher atar), velav ihi nishmeta deitdachyay vehacha ihu raza illaa, beetzev teldi vanim. raza da, da nachash, deha
937: Immeh olidat nishmatin, begin (338 170 amud alef) deda ihu al gufa, veda al nishmeta, vetarvavyyhu da beda. da nakit nishmeta, veda nakit gufa.

Uzemina da chivya, leolada kol innun gufin, ad la yete zimna dileh, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:7) beterem tachil yalada. zimna dechivya leolada besheva shenin, vehacha beshit, ma delav ihu zimneh. uvehahu zimna deolid lon, mehahu leda yamut. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) bila hammavet lanetzach. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 26:19) yichyu metecha nevelati yekumun.

Amar rabbi shimon, behahu zimna deyitarun mete alma, veyitattedun beara kaddisha, yekumun chayyaylin chayyaylin, kullehu al ara degalil, begin detamman zammin malka meshicha leitgallaa, begin deihu chulakeh deyosef, vetamman ittebaru (itcharav) bekadmita. umittamman sharu leaglaa mikkol atrayyhu, uleitbaddera bene amamaya, kema deat amer (Amos 6:6) velo nechlu al shever yosef.

Vaamay yekumun tamman, begin deihu chulakeh dehahu deishtave baarona, dichtiv, (Bereshit 50:26) vayyishem baaron bemitzrayim, ulevatar itkevar beara kaddisha, dichtiv, (Yehoshua 24:32) veet atzmot yosef asher heelu veni yisrael mimmitzrayim kavru vishchem. veda ihu dekaim bekiyyuma divrit, yattir mikkolla.

Uvehahu zimna deyitarun kullehu chayyaylin chayyaylin, kullehu yahachun, da lechulak avahathon, veda lechulak avahathon, dichtiv (Vayikra 25:10) veshavtem ish el achuzzato. veyishtemmodun da leda. vezammin kudesha berich hu lealbasha lon lechol chad vechad levushe merkkaman, veyetun kullehu vishabbechun lemarehon biyrushala 40, veyitchabberun tamman uchelosin uchelosin, viyrushala 40 yitmeshach lechol sitrin, yattir mimma deitmeshach kad itchabbaru tamman miggaluta.

Kevan deyitchabberun vishabbechun lemarihon, kudesha berich hu yechde immehon, hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:12) uvau verinnenu vimmerom tziyyon, ulevatar venaharu el tuv Adonai vegomer, kol chad vechad lechulakeh, vechulak avahatoy. veachasantehon deyisrael tehe, ad (nusach acher ramata daroma), demata deromae, vetamman yellefun orayyta, vha ukemuha, uchetiv (Yeshayahu 26:19) hakitzu verannenu shochne afar vegomer. barucha Adonai leolam amen veamen.
938: Kala nafik, veachriz veamar, istamru bene alma, teruku galle chovin, istallaku mershata detafis, ad la yittafsun raglayychu behay reshata. (235 amud bet) galgalla sachara tadir, salik venachit. vavy leinnun dedachyayn raglayyhu miggo galgalla, deha nafle lego umeka, detamir leinnun chayyayve alma.

Vavy leinnun denaflin vela yekumun, vela yinharu binhora deganiz letzaddikayyay lealma deate. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay lealma deate, dechamma nehorin genizin lon, kama iddunin behahu alma temirin lon, dichtiv ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha. ma rav tuvecha, ha ukemuha, da hu or deganiz letzaddikayyay lealma deate, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov, uchetiv (Tehillim 97:11) or zarua latztzaddik uleyishre lev simcha. veal da ma rav tuvecha.

Ketiv hacha ma rav tuvecha, uchetiv hatam vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. asher tzafanta, begin deistakkal kudesha berich hu behahu nehora, veistakkal beinnun chayyayvayya dizminin lemechote bealma, veganiz leh lehahu nehora, lemizke beh tzaddikayyay lealma deate, kema deittemar.

Paalta, bekadmita tzafanta, ulevatar paalta. ella tzafanta kema deittemar. paalta begin dehahu nehora deganiz, beh avid kudesha berich hu umanuta dealma. menalan. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, beavraham ketiv, vehahu nehora deavraham, ganiz leh kudesha berich hu, uveh avid umanuta dealma, dichtiv paalta lachosim bach, leinnun deyatve techot tzilla dekudesha berich hu.

Neged bene adam, deha behay umanuta deitavid behay nehora, kayymin bene nasha bealma, vekiyyuma dilhon havi. af al gav deihu ganiz, beh kayymin bene nasha bealma den. paalta, umanuta dealma da, deveh itavid kolla bechushebana, umanuta dealma, kegavvna da umanuta demashkena, deihu umanuta kegavvna dealma, veha okimna.

Ketiv hacha elle fekude hammishkan, uchetiv hatam elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz. begin dechol innun toladin deavdu veappiku shemaya veara, kullehu bechela dehahu nehora deganiz itavidu venafku. pekude hammishkan behahu chela nafku. menalan. dichtiv uvetzalel ben uri ven chur lematte yehuda, da ihu missitra (222 amud alef 236 amud alef) dimina. veitto oholiav da (220 amud bet) ihu missitra dismala. umashkena missitra dimina usemala ittekam veitavid. umoshe dehava benayyhu, okim leh.

Ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 16:5) vehuchan bachesed kisse veyyashav alav beemet vegomer. vehuchan bachesed kisse, ha okimna, kad machashava salik, biru dechedva mittemira dechol temirin dela ityeyda vela itdevak, mate hahu chedva, uvatash go machashava, ucheden al baatar deal.

Ad deitgeniz bechad hechala illaa, deihu tamir leel. umittamman nagdin veitmashshechan kol nehorin, dimina denatil bekadmita, ulevatar natil kullehu. umehahu setar yemina, itkan kuresyyay letatta. deha kudesha berich hu, atkin lehahu kuresyyay bechesed, veyashav alav beemet, deihu tikkuna dechotama decholla. vela yativ al hahu kuresyyay, ella bechotama da deihu emet. beohel david, deihu be kuresyyay letatta.

Shofet vedoresh mishpat umehir tzedek. shofet missitra dedina. vedoresh mishpat, missitra derachame. umehir tzedek, ihu kuresyyay dedina, deihu be dina letatta. ta chaze, kegavvna da, mashkena la ittakkan ella besitra da kegavvna da, dechesed kidkaamran leel, veal da itmenun toladin veittatkanu kullehu letatta.
(Shemot 38:21) elle fekude hammishkan mishkan haedut asher pukkad al pi moshe. rabbi shimon patach, bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz, hay kera
939: Ukemuha veittemar bechamma sitrin. aval kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, bara leh kegavvna dilella, lemeheve alma da bediyyukena dealma dilella. vechol innun gavvnin dilella, atkin lon letatta, leitdabbeka uleitkashshera alma bealma.

Vechad baa kudesha berich hu lemivre alma, ashgach beorayyta uvara leh. veistakkal bishma kaddisha, (Vayikra 19 amud alef 21 amud alef) kelala deorayyta, vekiyyem alma. bitlat sitrin itkayyaym alma, veinnun chachma utevuna vadaat. bechachma, dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:19) Adonai bechachma yasad aretz. bitvuna, dichtiv konen shamayim bitvuna. bedaat, dichtiv bedato tehomot nivkau. ha kullehu bekiyyuma dealma. uveillen telata itbene mashkena, dichtiv vaamalle oto ruach elohim bechachma bitvuna uvedaat.

Vechullehu telata remizin bikra da, bereshit, hayeynu dichtiv bechachma. bara elohim, hayeynu dichtiv bitvuna. et hashshamayim, hayeynu dichtiv bedaat. vechullehu ketive baavidat mashkena. uveraza da ketiv, elle fekude hammishkan, da raza dechachma. mishkan haedut, da raza ditvuna, asher pukkad al pi moshe, da raza dedaat. vecholla da lokovel da, begin dechol ma devara kudesha berich hu bealma den, bara leh kegavvna dilella. vecholla itreshim baavidat mashkena.

Ta chaze, beshaata deamar leh kudesha berich hu lemoshe avid mashkena, hava kaim moshe tohe, dela yada ma lemebad, ad deachze leh kudesha berich hu beena, kema dichtiv, (Shemot 25:40) uree vaase betavnitam asher atta mare bahar. may betavnitam. ella olifna, deachme leh kudesha berich hu lemoshe, diyyukena dechol milla umilla, kehahu diyyukena deihu leella, vechol chad vechad hava avid diyyukena dileh kediukena (deihu leella vechol chad have avid diyyukena dileh kadeyvekanea) deihu itavid beara.

Asher atta mare bahar, asher atta roe mibbae leh. ella olifna, deaspaklarya dela nahara, hava achme leh begaveh kol innun gavvnin vediyyukenin deitavedu letatta, kehay chezu deachze begaveh kol innun diukenin.

Mashma dichtiv asher atta mare, (138 amud bet) atta, raza deaspaklarya dela nahara, deachze leh begaveh kol innun diukenin. vahava chame lon moshe kol milla umilla al tikkuneh, kema dechame go ashashita, vego chezu deachze kol diukenin. vechad istakkal behu moshe, itkashe kammeh, amar leh kudesha berich hu, moshe, at besimanich, vaani besimani keden ityayshav moshe bechol avidta.

Kad itavid kol avidta, itzterich moshe lemimne kolla, begin dela yiyimrun yisrael deishtear kaspa vedahava, veistelik lenatla leh. veal da itzterich lemimni chushebana kammayyhu deyisrael, begin dichtiv, (Bamidbar lak) vihyitem nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael.

Uvegin da ketiv, elle fekude hammishkan mishkan haedut, deha rucha dekudesha, hava achze lecholla, chushebana dechol dahava vechaspa dindivu yisrael, veruach kudesha hava amar vechesef pekude haeda meat kikkar vegomer, kol hazzahav heasuy lammelacha vegomer. begin dekudesha berich hu itree behu, beinnun umanin, uvaa leappaka mehemnuta dilhon kamme kolla.

Elle fekude hammishkan. ta chaze, behahi shaata daavidta demashkena itavid, hava sitra achara azil veshat leastaa, vela ashkachat ila al mehemnuta deumanin, ad dekudesha berich hu kafif leh lekammeh demoshe, veihu avid chushebana dimhemnuta beal karcheh, vesalik mehemnuta dilhon legabbe kolla. veraza da dichtiv elle fekude hammishkan. veha okimna, elle: kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 49:15) gam elle (46 amud bet) tishkachna. uchetiv, asher pukkad al pi moshe, detamman itmene veitpekid, ad deitavid chushebana deve mashkena, kamme moshe veyisrael kullehu.
940: (Shemot 38:21) elle fekude hammishkan mishkan haedut. man edut. ella tere zimne ketiv hacha mishkan, chad leella, vechad letatta. umishkan ikre mishkan haedut. uman edut. kema deat amer (Tehillim 122:4) shivte yah edut leyisrael. shema da, ihu edut leyisrael.

Kegavvna da (Tehillim 81:6) edut bihosef samo, edut shem yah bihosef, ihu edut vadday, illen teren atvavn sahadin sahaduta bechol atar, vehacha ihu edut. uvegin kach, mishkan haedut, mashkena dehay edut. veal da mashkena ikre, al raza dishma da kaddisha. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Tehillim 132:12) veedoti zo alammedem, begin dehay atar, ihu setimu ugenizu decholla.

Asher pukkad al pi moshe, ad hacha la yedana, i hay mashkena pukkad, o hay edut. ella pukkad vadday hay edut. begin demin yoma deisteliku avahan mealma, vechol innun shevatin benoy deyaakov, veishtaaru yisrael begaluta, beinnun akan, itneshe minnayyhu yedia deraza dishma kaddisha illaa da, deihu (229 amud bet) shema deedut, kiuma dishmayya veara, deillen teren atvavn, okimu illae vetattae, vechullehu sitrin dealma.
Kevan deata moshe, itpekad veidkar shema da bealma. dechad hava bassene miyyad shail al shema da, dichtiv, (Shemot 3:13-14) veamru li ma shemo ma omar alehem. vetamman itpekad shema da al pi moshe.

Avodat haleviyyim, may avodat haleviyyim. ella raza da dichtiv, (Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu. hu: da raza dishma (vayyetze 154 amud bet) kaddisha, deikre hu, vela ikre atta. uvegin da avodat haleviyyim vadday. davar acher avodat haleviyyim, deinnun natlin mashkena al kitfayyhu meatar leatar, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 7:9) velivnay kehat lo natan ki avodat hakkodesh alehem bakkatef yissau.

(Shemot 38:21) elle fekude hammishkan mishkan haedut vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (Yeshayahu 11:10) vehaya bayyom hahu shoresh yishay vegomer. vehaya bayom hahu, bezimna dekudesha berich hu yasge shelama bealma, yitkayyem sharsha deilana dechayye, vehahu sharsha, minneh yitkayaymu shear sharashin letatta, dechullehu ishtarshan veitkayyman minneh.

Asher omed lenes ammim, dehay ihu kayyeyma lenisa uleat leraza dishma kaddisha. elav goyim yidroshu, detamman raza dekiyyuma dishma kaddisha, uvegin kach elav goyim yidroshu. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 2:3) vehalchu ammim rabbim veamru lechu venaale el har Adonai vegomer, veal da, elav goyim yidroshu. vehayta menuchato kavod, menuchato, da be makdesha. dichtiv, (Tehillim 132:14) zot menuchati ade ad. kavod, dehachi ikre kevod Adonai behahu zimna, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim.

Umenuchato dehahu shoresh yishay, deitkere kevod Adonai, la yitmene, vela yekum bechushebana lealma. may taama. (davar acher begin deha kayyeyma bechushebana hasheta vehahu zimna lo yitkayyem bechushebana. may tama) begin dechol ma dekayyeyma bechushebana, la sharyayn tamman birchan bishlimu. uvirkan sharyayn bemma dela kayyeyma bechushebana. bezimna kadmaa kayyeyma bechushebana, dichtiv elle fekude hammishkan.

Ta chaze, mashkena da kayyeyma bechushebana, uvegin kach itzterich litzlota demoshe, deyishre aleh birchan, dichtiv vayvarech otam moshe, uma beracha barich lon, yehe raava detishre beracha al ovade yedechon. uvirkan la sharan al hay chushebana ad deikshar leh moshe bemashkena dilella, dichtiv elle fekude hammishkan mishkan haedut asher pukkad al pi moshe. dei lav deitavad chushebana al yeda demoshe, la yachlin innun lemebad chushebana, dichtiv asher pukkad al pi moshe.

Patach veamar, (Melachim 1 17:8-9) vayhi devar Adonai el eliyahu lemor kum lech tzarfata vegomer hinne tzivviti sham isha almana lechalkelecha. vechi an pakid lah kudesha berich hu. ella ad la yete lealma, pakid kudesha berich hu bigzera dileh leella al haorvim, lemete mezona leeliyyahu, ulehahi itteta lemehav leh mezona.
941: (Melachim 1 17:12) vattomer chay Adonai elohecha im yesh li maog ki im melo chaf kemach bakkad umeat shemen batztzappachat vegomer. veha hacha medidu hava behahu kimcha, deha hava beh melo kaf kemach bakkad, kaf hu medidu dileh, veitchazze dela sharyayn beh birchan, hoil vekaim bemmidda. ma ketiv, (Melachim 1 17:14) ki cho amar Adonai elohe yisrael kad hakkemach lo tichla vetzappachat hashshemen lo techsar ad yom tet Adonai geshem.
Tet, titten ketiv, may taama. begin divchol dara la ishtechach man deyizke lizchu kehay itteta, veal da ketiv titten, ant titten mitra al alma, begin dizchutach saggi.

Uchetiv (Melachim 1 17:16) kad hakkemach lo chalata vetzappachat hashshemen lo chaser kidvar Adonai asher dibber beyad eliyyahu. vechi im hahu kimcha dekayyeyma bimdidu, dehava melo chaf kemach, la pasku minneh birchan begin milla deeliyyahu, dichtiv kad hakkemach lo tichla, uchetiv kad hakkemach lo chalata. mishkan haedut af al gav dekayyeyma bechushebana, hoil veitpekad al yeda demoshe, kol shekken vechol shekken desharyayn beh birchan. veal da ketiv, elle fekude hammishkan mishkan haedut asher pukkad al pi moshe.

(Shemot 38:21) elle fekude hammishkan. ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Shemot 3:Adonai) al tikrav halom shal nealecha meal raglecha vegomer. hay kera ukemuha, defarish leh kudesha berich hu meitteteh, begin leitdabbeka bishchinta, dichtiv, (Shemot 3:Adonai) ki hammakom asher atta omed alav admat kodesh hu. admat kodesh, da shechinta, itdabbekuta kaddisha itdabbak moshe behahi shaata leella.

Dichden kudesha berich hu kashir leh bachavivuta dilella, veitpekad rav memana al beta, veihu gazir, vekudesha berich hu avid, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 16:30) ufatzta haadama et piha vegomer, uchetiv (Bamidbar 16:31) vayhi kechalloto ledabber vegomer, vattibbaka haadama. uchetiv, (Bamidbar 10:35) kuma Adonai. shuva Adonai. hada hu dichtiv asher pukkad al pi moshe. al pi moshe ittakkan, veitpekad becholla. (vayyetze 159 amud bet) pekida demishkan hava al yeda demoshe, dichtiv (Shemot 3:16) pakod pakadti etchem, deihu hava kol, deappik lehahu dibbur, veavid leh pekida lenafka min galuta. vehasheta itpakda leamshacha kedushsha meella letatta, kema deat amer (Shemot 25:8) veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham.

(Shemot 38:22) uvetzalel ben uri ven chur lematte yehuda vegomer. amar ribbi yehuda, ha ittemar, deha betzalel missitra dimina hava, veihu atkin tikkuna decholla. vetu, deha yehuda ihu shallita umalka al kol shear shevatin, uminneh nafak man deatkin kol mashkena. betzalel, ha ukemuha, betzel el, uman ihu betzel el. da yemina. vetu, missitra da atkin kolla, veyarit chachmeta lemebad kol avida.

Veitto oholiav ben achisamach lematte dan, da ihu missitra dismala, da ihu missitra dedina kashya, (nusach acher kaddisha) veha ukemuha, deha mitteren sitrin illen, itavid mashkena, veittakkan behu, leitkashshera behu, lemeheve ben yemina usemala, veha ittemar veukemuha.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 48:3) yefe nof mesos kol haaretz har tziyyon yarkete tzafon kiryat melech rav. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, ashde chad avna yakkira mittechot kurse yekareh, veshaka ad tehoma, veresha chada dehahu avna naitz go tehome, veresha achara leella, vehahu resha achara illaa, ihu chad nekuda (ilaa) dekayyeyma beemtzaita dealma, umittamman itpashat alma limina usemala ulechol sitrin, veitkayyaym behahi nekuda emtzaita, vehahi avna itkere shetiyya, deminah ishtil alma lechol sitrin. tu (vaychi 231 amud alef) shetiyya, shat yah, kudesha berich hu shavve lah lemeheve yesoda dealma ushetilu decholla.
