942: Bitlat gavvnin itpashshetat ara sacharaneh dehahu nekuda, itpashshetuta kadmaa, sacharaneh dehahu nekuda, kol tzachuta uzechuta deara kayyeyma tamman, vetamman ihu. vehay kayyeyma leella al kol ara sacharaneh dehahu nekuda. itpashshetuta tinyayna, sacharaneh dehahu itpashshetuta kadmaa, lav ihu tzachuta vezakkuta kehahu kadmaa, aval ihu dakik vetzach betzachuta deafra, yattir mikkol shear afar achara. itpashshetuta telitaa, ihu chashuch vegasu deafra yattir mekullehu, vesacharaneh dehay, kayymin mayin deyamma deokyyaynos, deaschar kol alma. ishtechach dehahu nekuda kayyeyma beemtzaita, vechullehu gavvnin deitpeshatuta dealma sacharaneh.

Itpashshetuta kadmaa ihu be makdesha, vechol innun hechalin vaazarot, vechol hahu tikkuna dileh, viyrushala 40, vechol mata mishshura ulego. itpashshetuta tinyayna, kol ara deyisrael deitkaddeshat bikdushsha. itpashshetuta telitaa, ihu kol shear ara, atar be motva dishar ammin. veyamma deokyyaynos desachara kolla.

Veha (226 amud alef) ukemuha, deraza da gavvnin deena, desacharan lehahu nekuda deemtzaita deena, deihu chezu dechol ena, kegavvna dehahi nekuda emtzaita dekaamran, deihu chezu decholla, vetamman kaim bet kodesh hakkadashim, vearon vechapporet, deinnun chezu decholla. ishtechach, hahu nekuda chezu dechol alma. veal da ketiv, yefe nof mesos kol haaretz har tziyyon vegomer. yefe: shappir hahu chezu vechedva decholla. nof: nofa deilana deihu shefiru decholla.

Ta chaze, shefiru dealma, vechezu dealma, la itchaze bealma, ad deitbene veittekam mashkena, veal arona lego kudesha. mehahi shaata, itchaze chezu decholla bealma, veittakkan alma, veazle behahu mashkena uvehahu arona, ad demate lehahi nekuda deihi yefe nof chedva decholla. kevan dematu lehatam keden patach arona veamar, (Tehillim 132:14) zot menuchati ade ad po eshev ki ivvitiha.

Ribbi yesa amar, hay kera keneset yisrael amra leh, beshaata deitbene be makdesha, veal arona leatreh. ribbi chizkiyya amar, kudesha berich hu amar leh, al keneset yisrael, kad yisrael avdin reuteh, deha keden kudesha berich hu yativ al kurese yekareh, vechayyis al alma, uveracha veshalom vachavivuta decholla ishtechach. ucheden amar zot menuchati ade ad.

Veta chaze, beshaata dechullehu omanin sharu lemebad umanuta, hahu ovada mammash desharan, ihi ishtelimat miggarmah. innun sharan, veihi ashlimat avidta, ihi mammash, menalan, dichtiv vattechel kol avodat mishkan ohel moed.

Kegavvna da (Bereshit 2:2) vaychullu hashshamayim vehaaretz. vei tema, vaychal elohim bayom hashshevii. vadday hachi hu, dechol alma, af al gav dechol avidan ishtelimu kol chad vechad, alma kolla la hava shelim bekiyyumeh, ad deata yoma sheviaa, dechad ata yoma sheviaa, keden ishtelimu kol avidan, veashlim beh kudesha berich hu alma, hada hu dichtiv vaychal elohim bayom hashshevii melachto asher asa. behay, ishtelim bekiyyuma kol avidta deavad, veal da vaychal elohim beyom hashshevii.

Vechad itbene be makdesha, kol avidta deitavid, ihi miggarmah itavidat umanin sharan, veavidta itchaziat lon lemebad, veitreshimat kamayyhu, veishtelimat hi miggarmah. veha ukemuha, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 6:7) vehabbayit behibbanoto. vehabbayit kaasher banuhu la ketiv. ella behibbanoto. deihi ishtelimat miggarmah. uchetiv even shelema massa nivna. banuhu la ketiv. ella nivna hu miggarmeh nivna, vechen bechol avidta deihi kaddisha, ihi ishtelimat miggarmah.
943: (Shemot 38:22) uvetzalel ben uri ven chur. hay kera olifna, deruach kudesha achriz aleh leenehon deyisrael, veamar uvetzalel ben uri ven chur lematte yehuda asa et kol asher tzivva Adonai et moshe. veitto oholiav ben achisamach. may veitto. ella olifna, deoholiav la avid avidta bilchodoy, ella im betzalel, veimmeh aved kol ma deavad. hada hu dichtiv veitto, veitto vela bilchodoy. mikkan dismala ihi bichlal yemina tadir. veal da ketiv vaani hinne natatti itto et oholiav, da yemina veda (220 amud bet) semala.

(Shemot 38:21) elle fekude hammishkan mishkan haedut asher pukkad al pi moshe vegomer. ribbi yesa amar, kevan deavdu kol chakkimayyay yat mashkena, itzterich lemehadar chushebana, mikkol innun avidan deitavedu beh. may taama. begin dechol chusheban vechusheban, kad hava itavid chushebana, hachi itkayyaym hahu avida, veitkayyaym beatreh.

Veyisrael kullehu kema deitreu bema dindivu bekadmita, hachi name itreu behahu chushebana, ucheden itkayyaym kol avida, behahu reuta. veal da itzterich hacha chushebana, begin divhay itkayyaym avida. elle ketiv, vela ketiv veelle. ella da ihu chushebana defasil kol chushebanin dealma, veda itkayyaym yattir mikkullehu, divhay itkayyaym mashkena, vela beachara.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 33:6) vehaya emunat ittecha chosen yeshuot chachmat vadaat yirat Adonai hi otzaro. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay, aval ha tanenan, kol bar nash deitassak beorayyta behay alma, vezache lemikba ittin lah, itzterich beemuna, diruta dileh yitkavven lekudesha berich hu, yitkavven leshem shamayim, begin deemuna lehachi itkevavn. chosen yeshuot, leachlela rachame bedina. chachmat vadaat, ditren illen sharan da al da. da tamir veganiz, leashraa da al da.

Yirat Adonai hi otzaro. otzaro dechol illen, begin dehay yirat Adonai, nakit kol innun nachalin, veihi itavidat otzar lechullehu. vechad nafkin minnah kol innun genizin kullehu, appik lon bechushebana. menalan. dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:Adonai) enayich berechot becheshobbon. becheshobbon vadday avid, veappik innun berechot mayim, veashgach leappaka kolla bechushebana. (nusach acher vaashakev lecholla).

Veal da ikre emuna. uvecholla ikre emuna, veha okimna. uma i hacha itzterich leachazaa mehemnuta, lishar mille dealma al achat kamma vechamma. veal da, kudesha berich hu hava oda lehu lechol yisrael, raza dimhemnuta dilhu, bechol ma deavdu, vecholla ittemar.

Ribbi yose veribbi yitzchak havo azle bearcha, amar ribbi yose, vadday dekudesha berich hu itree beh bivtzalel laavidat mashkena, yattir mikkol yisrael, amay. amar leh, shema garim, veha okmuha, dekudesha berich hu shavve shemahan beara, leitattera (sefer acher leitteara) behu, ulemebad behu avidta bealma, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 46:9) asher sam shammot baaretz.

Amar leh, raza ihu hacha, yehuda missetar semala hava, veahdar veitdabbak bimina. veal da, besitra da itavid mashkena, share missetar semala, veitdabbak bistar yemina, ulevatar itkelil da beda, veitavid kolla yemina. kegavvna da orayyta, share missemala, veitdabbak bimina, veitkelil da beda, veitavid kolla yemina. reuven shara mimina, vesata lismala, venatlu immeh innun shear shevatin, deinnun semala, begin deshari mimina vesata lismala.

Yehuda shara missemala, vesata limina, shara missemala, begin deate missetar semala, veitdabbak bimina, umashkena besitra da itavid. share mistar semala, veitdabbak bistar yemina, veal da, betzalel ihu deate missitreh, aved mashkena veittakkan legabbeh. veha ukemuha, dekudesha berich hu itree beh, uvarir leh mikkolla
944: Veyahav leh chachma utevuna vadaat, kema deukemuha. begin deimmeh hava bekadmita sachletanu delibba, dichtiv uvelev kol chacham lev natatti chachma. begin dekudesha berich hu la yahiv chachmeta, ella leman deit beh chachmeta, veukemuha chavrayyay veittemar. vechen kegavvna da betzalel. ribbi shimon amar, betzalel shemeh garim leh, veal chachmateh ikre hachi, veraza demilla betzalel, betzel el.

Patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 2:3) ketappuach baatze hayyaar ken dodi vegomer. betzillo: hayeynu betzalel, deihu atkin mashkena, veavid leh. dichtiv chimmadti veyashavti. demashkena chamida ihu lemetav beh, deihu avid chimmuda lichneset yisrael, ucheneset yisrael yatva betzilla deel. veda ihu betzalel.

Ufiryo matok lechikki, deda (214 amud bet) ihu deavid perin tavin bealma, dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:9) mimmenni peryecha nimtza. man hu peri. illen innun nishmathon detzaddikayyay, deinnun ibba deovadoy dekudesha berich hu. dehahu nahar denafik meeden, ihu appik vezarik nishmatin lealma, veinnun perin dekudesha berich hu, ubbegin kach piryo. da ihu kidkaamran.

Betzillo: da hu betzalel. veal da tikkuna demashkena al yeda divtzalel hava. ubbegin kach uvetzalel ben uri ben chur. ben uri, da nehora deshimsha denafik. ben uri, da yemina. ben chur, da ihu semala. ben uri ben chur, (sefer acher ben chur ben chore) veal da ishtelim beh dina dekudesha berich hu beovada deegla.

(Shemot 38:24) kol hazzahav heasuy. mehahi shaata deyahavu leh yisrael, hava asuy veittakkan mikkadmat dena, bechol melechet hakkodesh, kol hahu dahava, itavid veittakkan bechol melechet hakkodesh. may taama. begin divchol darga vedarga, hava ittakkan beh dahava. delet shelimu ella rachame vedina, veal da dahava hava azil bechol melechet hakkodesh, bechol hahi avidta deikre kodesh, hava azil ba dahava, dahava becholla.

Ribbi abba ribbi yose veribbi chizkiyya havo yatvin velaan beorayyta, amar leh ribbi chizkiyya leribbi abba, ha chamenan dekudesha berich hu itree bedina becholla, leitarva da beda, veihu arich dina bechayyayve alma, i ihu itere bedina, amay salik leh mechayyayvayya. amar leh, kama turin itakkeru bemilla da, aval kama millin galle butzina kaddisha behay.

Veta chaze, dina dekudesha berich hu itree beh, ihu dina barir, ihu dina (58 64 amud alef) deittear rechimu vechedva. aval chayyayvayya kad innun bealma, kullehu dina dezuhama. kullehu dina dela itree beh kudesha berich hu kelal. veal da, la bae leitarva dina kaddisha bedina misava dezuhama, ad deihu ishtetze miggarmeh, uleovada leh min alma deate, vehahu dina dezuhama deveh ihu ovid leh mealma.

Patach veamar (Tehillim 92:8) bifroach reshaim kemo esev vayyatzitzu kol poale aven lehishshamdam ade ad, hay kera ukemuha, aval ta chaze, bifroach reshaim kemo esev. kehay isba deihu bivishu deara, veihu yevesha, kad sharan beh mayya afriach, vehahu yevishu itperach. uchehay ilana ketzitza denatzitz, vela salik ella innun peerot, listar da velistar da, deinnun anfin desallekin, ulealmin la salik ilana, kad hava bekadmita lemeheve ilana. vechol da, lehishshamdam ade ad, leakera lon mishsharashin umikkolla.

Tu raza achara it behay, al dekudesha berich hu arich rugezeh bechayyayvayya behay alma, begin dehay alma, ihu chulaka desitra achara. vealma deate ihu sitra dikdushsha. veihu chulaka detzaddikayyay, lemeheve tzaddikayyay innun baatara diykara demarehon beh. uteren sitrin illen, kayymin da lokovel da. da
945: Sitra dikdushsha. veda sitra achara dimsaava. da kayyeyma letzaddikayyay, veda kayyeyma lerashiayyay, vecholla da lokovel da. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, delet lon chulaka behay alma, ella bealma deate.

Ta chaze kolla ittakkan veitgele kamme kudesha berich hu. veaf al gav devalak uvilam la itkavvnu legabbe kudesha berich hu, kolla ihu mittakkan kammeh, vela gara meagar dilhon kelum behay alma. behahu zimna shelitu al yisrael, degaram hahu kurebana, leistalleka miyisrael arbaa veesrin alfin, bar kol innun deitketalu, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 25:5) hargu ish anashav hannitzmadim levaal peor, uchetiv kach et kol rashe haam vehoka otam laAdonai. vead kean hahu karbana hava tale leitpara minnehon deyisrael. shiva madbechan kechushevan arbein uteren.

Ribbi shimon amar, ta chaze, innun arbein uteren karbanin avdu bilam uvalak, venatlu lon mehahu sitra achara legabbe kudesha berich hu, veal da hava tale hahu karbena, lenatla leh hahu sitra achara deikre kelala miyisrael, vead hasheta la gava minnayyhu. veda ihu raza (Melachim 2 2:24) vayyifen acharav vayyirem. vayyifen acharav, achore shechinta, dekayyeyma sitra achara laachora. vayyirem. istakkal behu hahu sitra achara, vechama lon deitchazun leitannesha, veal da vaykallem beshem Adonai. beshem Adonai leappaka hahu shem Adonai mechiyyuva da. mehahu chiuva dehahu karban deakriv hahu sitra legabbeh. vecholla ihu mittakkan kammeh dekudesha berich hu, vela itavid milla. kegavvna da, kolla ittakkan kameh dekudesha berich hu, hen letav hen levish.

Ta chaze, david ihu hava dearak kameh deshaul. veal da garim, deitavidu kol innun kahane denov, vela ishtear mekullehu bar evyatar bilchodoy dearak. veda garim kama bishin beyisrael, umit shaul uvenoy, venaflu miyisrael kama alfin veribbevan. veim kol da, hahu chova hava tale al david ligvot minneh, ad dechol benoy dedavid itavidu beyoma chad, vela ishtear minnayyhu ella yoash bilchodoy, deitgeniv. kegavvna dela ishtear meachimelech bar evyatar bilchodoy. vead kean hahu chova hava tale, lemebad dina al nov, al hahu chova denov, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 10:32) od hayyom benov laamod veukemuha.

Kegavvna da, kol hazzahav heasuy lammelacha. may heasuy. hacha istakkal kudesha berich hu, kad yahavu yisrael dahava leegla, vekudesha berich hu akdim (195 amud alef) lon dahava da leasvavta, dehay dahava demashkena akdim lon, lehahu dahava deyahavu leegla, dechol dahava dehava immehon, veishtechach immehon, yahavu learamat mashkena. salleka datach, dechad avdu yat egla ishtechach immehon dahava, veinnun periku udenayyhu lenatla hahu dahava, dichtiv, (Shemot 32:3) vayyitparaku kol haam et nizme hazzahav asher beaznehem. veal da akdim dahava dearamuta. lechappera al ovada da. (chaser) (uvegin kach)

Uvetzalel ben uri ben chur lematte yehuda, missitra demalchuta asa et kol asher tzivva Adonai et moshe. deha kol umanuta demashkena ittakkenat behu, veal yedayyhu. betzalel ihu avid umanuta, umoshe ihu atkin kolla levatar. moshe uvetzalel kachada havo, moshe leella, betzalel techoteh, siyyuma (259 amud alef, 214 amud bet) degufa kegufa. betzalel veoholiav, ha ukemuha, da yemina, veda semala, vecholla chad. ubbegin kach, uvetzalel ben uri ben chur lematte yehuda vegomer, veitto oholiav ben achisamach lematte dan vegomer.

(Shemot 38:24) kol hazzahav heasuy lammelacha bechol melechet hakkodesh vegomer. ribbi yose patach kera beelisha, dichtiv, (Melachim 2 2:23) vayyaal misham bet el vehu ole badderech vegomer. unearim ketannim. ha ukemuha, menuarim havo mikkol mille orayyta umikkol pikkude orayyta. ketannim
946: Zeire mehemnuta, veitchayyeyvu bechiuva dehay alma, uvechiyyuva dealma deate. yatzu min hair, nafku meraza dimhemnuta. ketiv hacha yatzu min hair, uchetiv hatam (Hoshea 11:9) velo avo beir. (sefer acher meraza dimhemnuta ikre ir 1 ir Adonai tzevaot ir elohenu).

Vayyifen acharav vayyirem, vayyifen acharav, deistakkal laachora, i yehadrun betiuveta, veim lav. vayyirem, may vayyirem. istakkal behu, deha let zara metatkena zammin lenafka minnayyhu, veukemuha. vayyirem, ha ukemuha, deitavedu belelya dechippure. miyyad vaykallem beshem Adonai.

Veraza ihu behay kera, vayyifen acharav, istakkal behu, i yitanesh alayyhu, veitpene mehay. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 12:10) vayyifen aharon, deitpene mitztzarateh. uf hacha itpeni meonsha dilhon. vayyirem, dahavo kayymin levatar lemebad kama bishin beyisrael.

Vayyifen acharav, kema deat amer (Bereshit 19:26) vattabbet ishto meacharav. may meacharav. meachore shechinta. uf hacha vayyifen acharav, istakkal meachore shechinta. vechama lechullehu, deha behahu lelya deshalta al kappara dechovehon deyisrael, itabbaru immehon minnayyhu, miyyad vaykallem beshem Adonai. vattetzena shetayim dubbim min hayyaar. shetayim dubbim, shenayim dubbim mibbae leh, may shetayim dubbim. nukevin havo, uvenayyhu. vattevakkana mehem arbaim ushenayim yeladim, ha ukemuha lokovel karbanin devalak.

(Shemot 38:24) vayhi zehav hattenufa, amay ikre zehav hattenufa, vela ikre hachi kesef hattenufa. ella, teren innun deikrun hachi. zehav hattenufa, unechoshet hattenufa. vela ikre hachi kesef hattenufa, ella illen ikrun hachi, begin deihu istalkuta leella, deha it hachi letatta. velav ihu zahav (kegavvna) dearamuta. uvechol atar tenufa ihu aramuta leella vela lenachta letatta.

Veihu raza dechushebana da, dechol illen dargin uretichin kullehu, kayyme bearamuta (da), veihu dehav aramuta, veda ihu dahava. dechol ma demitpashsheta letatta, astim chezu vetivu unehiru dileh, vechad ihu bearamuta, keden ihu dehav tav beraza dinhiru dileh. vechol hahu diltatta, susefita dedahava, veihu hittucha dileh.

(Shemot 38:25) vechesef pekude haeda, begin dehay, ihu kol ma deitpashshat letatta hachi hu tav, veaf al gav delav ihu behay aramuta, kolla hu letav. aval dahava, kol ma deitpashshat letatta, kolla hu levish. da, itpashat letav. veda itpashat levish. uvegin kach, da itzterich learama aramuta, uleistalleka leella. veda, itzterich leitpashta letatta, ulechol sitrin, begin dechullehu kaim letav.

Patach veamar (Tehillim 84:12) ki shemesh umagen Adonai vegomer. ki shemesh, da kudesha berich hu. umagen, da kudesha berich hu. shemesh: da hu raza dishma kaddisha Adonai, dehacha kayymin kol dargin lenayycha. umagen; da ihu raza dishma kaddisha deikre elohim. veraza da dichtiv, (Bereshit 15:1) anochi magen lach. veshemmesh umagen da ihu raza dishma shelim. chen vechavod yitten Adonai, lemeheve kolla raza chada.

Lo yimna tov laholchim betamim, raza da (hahu) dichtiv, (Iyov 38:15) veyimmana mershaim oram. veda ihu nehora kadmaa, dichtiv beh (Bereshit 1:4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov, deganiz vesatim leh kudesha berich hu, kema deukemuha, umin chayyayvayya ganiz leh, umana leh behay alma, uvealma deate. aval letzaddikayyay ma ketiv, lo yimna tov laholchim betamim. da or kadmaa dichtiv beh vayar elohim et haor ki tov.

Veal da, la itzterich da leistalleka ulearama leh, ella leitpashta uleitgallaa, vela leistalleka kehahu achara, deihu semala, veal da ikre hahu tenufa, velav hay. ubbegin kach vechesef pekude haeda meat kikkar vegomer.
Ta chaze, sitra dimina, ihu tadir kayyeyma lekayyeyma bechol alma, uleanhara
947: Ulevarcha leh. ubbegin kach, kahana deihu missitra dimina, izdeman tadir levarcha amma, deha missitra dimina, atyayn kol birchan dealma, vechahana natil beresha, veal da itmana ihu levarcha leella uletatta.

Ta chaze, beshaata dechahana paris yedoy levarcha amma, keden shechinta atya vesharya alohi, veamle yedoy, yeda dimina zakfa leella al yeda dismala, begin lesalleka yemina, uleitgabbera al semala. ucheden kullehu dargin deka paris behu yedoy, kullehu itbarchan mimmekora decholla. mekora devera man ihu. da tzaddik. (261 amud alef) mekora decholla, da ihu alma deate, deihu mekora illaa dechol anpin nehirin mittamman, deha ihu mabbua umekora decholla. vechol butzinin unehorin, mittamman itdeliku.

Kegavvna da, mekora umabbua devera, kol innun butzinin diltatta, kullehu itnaharin veitmalyayn nehorin minneh. veda kayyeyma lokovel da. ubbegin kach, beshaata dechahana paris yedoy, veshari levarcha amma. keden sharan birchan illain, mimmekora illaa, leadleka butzinin, venaharin kol anpin. uchenset yisrael itatterat beitrin illain. vechol innun birchan nagdin veitmashshechan meella letatta.

Ta chaze, moshe pakid, uvetzalel avid, lemeheve kolla beraza degufa, (224 amud alef) vesiyyuma degufa deihu at kayyayma kaddisha, leasgaa rechimu vekishshura deyichuda bemashkena. vecholla beraza dimina ka itavid. veal da, bechol atar desitra dimina ishtechach, ena bisha la shalta beh. ubbegin kach, vachesef pekude haeda. begin dehahu kesef missitra dimina ka atya. veal da itmanna kolla beminyayna.

Ribbi yitzchak shail lerabbi shimon, amar leh, ha ukemuha devircheta la sharya bemilla dekaim bimdidu, uvemilla dekaim bechushebana, hacha bemashkena amay hava kolla bechushebana. amar leh ha ittemar, aval bechol atar desitra dikdushsha sharya aleh, i hahu chushebana atya missitra dikdushsha, birchata sharya aleh tadir, vela itade minneh. menalan. mimmaaser. begin deatya chushebana lekaddesha. birchata ishtechachat beh. kol shekken mashkena deihu kodesh, veatya missitra dekodesh.

Aval kol shear mille dealma, dela atyayn missitra dikdushsha, birchata la sharya alayyhu, kad innun bechushebana. begin desitra achara, deihu ra ayin, yachil leshalletaa aleh. vechevan deyachil leshalletaa aleh, birchata la ishtechachat beh, begin dela yimtu birchan lehahu ra ayin. (velo have missitra dikdushsha).

Umedidu dikdushsha, vechushebana dikdushsha, tadir birchan ittosfan beh. veal da, vechesef pekude haeda. pekude haeda bekusheta vadday, vela dechilu meena bisha, vela dechilu mikkol chushebana da, deha becholla sharan birchan milleella.

Veta chaze, vezara deyosef la shalta beh ena bisha, begin deate missitra dimina, veal da itavid mashkena al yeda divtzalel, deha ihu beraza deyosef ka sharya, deihu raza divrit kaddisha. veal da, moshe pakid, uvetzalel avid, lemeheve kolla beraza degufa, vesiyyuma degufa, deihu at kayyayma kaddisha, leasgaa rechimu vekishshura deyichuda bemashkena, vecholla beraza dimina ka itavid, uvegin kach vechesef pekude haeda, vehahu chushebana, ihu chusheban dargin ravrevin memanan, deitachadan missitra dimina. veal da ketiv meat kikkar vegomer.

Ribbi abba, veribbi acha, veribbi yose, havo azle mitteverya letzippori, ad dahavo azle, chamu leh leribbi elazar dehava ate, veribbi chiyay immeh. amar ribbi abba, vadday nishtattef bahade shechinta. orichu lehu, ad dematu legabbayyhu. kevan dematu gabbayyhu, amar ribbi elazar, ketiv (tehillim la) eni Adonai el tzaddikim veaznav el shavatam. hay kera kashya, may eni Adonai el tzaddikim. i begin deashgachuta dekudesha berich hu alayyhu leotava lon behay alma, ha chamenan, kama zakkain innun behay alma, vaafillu mezona keorve bara la yachlin
948: Leadbeka, i hachi may ene Adonai el tzaddikim.

Ella raza hacha, ta chaze, kol innun biryayn dealma, kullehu ishtemodan leella, ben lesitra da, uven lesitra da. innun dilsitra dikdushsha, ishtemodan leella legabbeh, veashgachuta dileh tadir alayyhu. veinnun dilsitra misava, ishtemodan legabbeh, veashgachuta dileh tadir alayyhu. uvaatar deshalta hahi ashgachuta desitra dikdushsha, la ashgach aleh sitra achara, vela yikrav legabbeh lealmin, vela yachil ledachyay leh meatreh, becholla, bechol ma deihu avid. veal da, ene Adonai el tzaddikim vegomer, begin da sitra achara la yachil leshalletaa aleh. vehasheta siyyayta dishmayya hacha, vechol ashgachuta tava dilella hacha, vechol sitra achara, vechol milla bisha, la yachil leshalletaa alayychu.

Amar ribbi abba, ha olifna divchol atar desitra dikdushsha sharya aloy, af al gav dekayyeyma bechushebana, birchata la itmenna mittamman. amar ribbi elazar, vadday hachi hu. amar leh, ha yisrael innun kodesh, veatyayn missitra dekodesh, dichtiv (yirmeya 2) kodesh yisrael laAdonai, uchetiv (Vayikra 20:26) vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani, amay kad aved david chushebana leyisrael, hava behon motana, dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 24:15) vayitten Adonai dever beyisrael min habboker vead et moed.

Amar leh, begin dela natal minnayyhu shekalim, deihu purekana. dichtiv, (Shemot 30:12) venatnu ish chofer nafsho laAdonai bifkod otam velo yihye vahem negef bifkod otam. begin deitzterich kodesh, (deihu beitgalleyay) lemehav purekana dekodesh, vehahi purekana dekodesh la itnetil minnayyhu. ta chaze, yisrael ihu kodesh, dekayyeyma bela chushebana, (degarmayyhu) veal da itzterich purekana deyitnetil minnayyhu, vehahu purekana kayyeyma bechushebana, veinnun la kayymu bechushebana.

May tama. begin dekodesh ihu raza illaa dechol dargin, ma hahu kodesh ihu salik al kolla, veit leh levar kodesh achara letatta dekayyeyma techoteh, vekaim bechushebana uveminyayn. uf hachi yisrael innun kodesh, dichtiv kodesh yisrael laAdonai, veinnun yahave kodesh achara, purekan dilhon, dekayyme bechushebana, veraza da, yisrael innun ilana dekayyeyma lego, purekana (nusach acher kodesh) achara kayyeyma levar, vesalik lechushebana, veagin da al da. azlu.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Hoshea 2:1) vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam asher lo yimmad velo yissafer vegomer. mahu kechol hayyam. teren gavvnin innun hacha. chada kechol hayyam, begin deyamma kad sallekin galoy bezapa verugeza, veinnun gallin sallekan leshattefa alma, kad matan vechaman chola deyamma, miyyad itbaru vetavin laachora, veishtechache, vela yachlin leshaltaa uleshatfa alma.

Kegavvna da, yisrael innun chola deyamma, vechad shear ammin deinnun galle yamma, mare derugeza, mare dedinin kashin, baan leshaltaa uleshatfa alma, chaman lehu leyisrael deinnun mitkashsheran bekudesha berich hu, vetavin veitbaru kammayyhu, vela yachlin leshaltaa bealma. gavvna achara, begin dechola deyamma let leh chushebana, vela kayyeyma bechushebana, vela bimdidu, dichtiv asher lo yimmad velo yissafer, uf hachi yisrael let lehu chushebana, vela kayyeymin bechushebana.

Ta chaze, it medidu tamir veganiz, veit chusheban dekayyeyma bignizu tamir veganiz, vehay kayyeyma bimdidu, vehay kayyeyma bechusheban. veda ihu raza vekiyyuma decholla dilella vetatta, begin dehahu medidu la ityeyda lealmin, al ma kayyeyma raza dehahu medidu. veal ma kayyeyma raza dehahu chushebana, veda ihu raza dimhemnuta decholla.
Veyisrael letatta la kayymin bechushebana, ella besitra demilla achara, ufurekana ihu dekayyeyma bechushebana. uvegin kach yisrael kad alin
949: Bechushebana natle minnayyhu purekana kema deittemar. veal da beyomoy dedavid, kad aved chushebana beyisrael, vela natil minnehon purekana, hava rugeza, veitavidu miyisrael kama chelin vechamma mashiryayn.

Ubbegin kach ketiv beovada demashkena, vechesef pekude haeda vegomer, vechol haover al happekudim. vecholla itkaddash laavidat mashkena, veha ukemuha kikkarin chushebana chada. shekalim chushebana chada. begin deit illain desalkan lechushebana illaa, veit acharanin desalkan lechushebna achara. da illaa veda tattaa. uvegin kach ketiv vayhi meat kikkar hakkesef latzeket et adne hakkodesh vegomer. illen adanim ha ukemuha.

Tu patach veamar, (Tehillim 127:1) shir hammaalot lishlomo im Adonai lo yivne vayit vegomer, hay kera shelomo malka amar leh, beshaata dehava bane be makdesha veshari lemivne, vahava chame deovada ittaknat bidayyhu, vahava mitbene miggarmeh, keden share veamar im Adonai lo yivne vayit vegomer, hayeynu raza dichtiv bereshit bara elohim, deha kudesha berich hu, bara veatkin lehay alma, bechol ma deitzterich, deihu bayit.

Shav amlu vonav bo, illen raza deinnun naharin, (nusach acher nachalin) denafkin vealin kullehu bego hay bayit, leatkena leh bechol ma deitzterich. veaf al gav dechullehu ka atyayn leatkena lemebad tikkuneh, vadday im Adonai, deihu raza dealma illaa, deatkin (sefer acher beteh lo atkin) veavid beta kedka yeot, innun bonin lemaggana innun, ella ma deihu avid veatkin. im Adonai lo yishmar ir, kema dichtiv (Devarim 11:12) tamid ene Adonai elohecha ba merishit hashshana vead acharit shana veokmuha. uveashgachuta da, ihi netira bechol sitrin.

Veaf al gav dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:7-8) hinni mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah miggibbore yisrael. vechullehu natre lah. may tama natre lah. begin dichtiv mippachad ballelot, da pachda degehinnam, dekaim lokovla, begin ledachyay lah, uvegin da kullehu sacharin lah. (nidpas 268 amud bet)
Veaf al gav dechullehu kayyme binhiru demachashava dela ityeyda. ucheden, hay nehiru demachashava dela ityeyda, batash binhiru difrisa venaharin kachada veitavidu (269 amud alef) tesha hechalin.

Vehechalin lav innun nehorin, velav innun ruchin, velav innun nishmatin, vela it man dekayyeyma behu. reuta dechol tesha nehorin dekayyme kullehu bemachashava, deihi chad minnayyhu bechushebana, dechullehu lemirdaf avatrayyhu, beshaata dekayyme bemachashava. vela mitdabbekan, vela ityeydiu, illen la kayyme, la biruta, vela bemachashava illaa. tafsin bah vela tafsin. beillen kayymin kol raze mehemnuta, vechol innun nehorin meraza demachashava illaa. diltatta kullehu ikrun en sof. ad hacha matun nehorin vela matun, vela ityeydiu. lav hacha machashava velav reuta.

Kad nahir machashava, velav ityeyda mimma nahir keden itlabbash veastim go bina, venahir (man) lemma denahir, veail da beda, ad deitkelilu kullehu kachada, veha ukemuha. uveraza dekarbena, kad salik kolla, itkashshar da beda, venahir da beda, keden kayymin kullehu bisliku, umachashava itattar been sof, hahu nehiru denahir minneh machashava illaa, ikre en sof. (ad kan)
Kevan deanhir veitpashshatu minneh chelin, hahi machashava astim veagniz vela yedia, umittamman itpashshat peshituta lechol sitrin, veitpashshat minneh chad peshitu, deihu raza dealma illaa.

Veda kayyeyma (31 amud alef) bishsheelta, veihu maamar illaa, veukemuha deikre mi. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) seu marom enechem ureu mi vara elle. sheelta hahu devara elle. levatar itpashat veitavid yam, (56 amud alef) sofa dechol dargin, deihu letatta. umittamman share lemivne letatta. vecholla avid behahu gavvna mammash
950: Dilella da, lokovel da. veda kegavvna deda. uvegin kach, netiru decholla meella vetatta.

Vehay peshitu, demachashava ihu, deihu alma illaa. veda ihu im Adonai lo yishmar ir shav shakad shomer, deihu shomer yisrael. (nusach acher shoked shomer hahu dichtiv beh 0 veshomer adonav ykevabed) delav beh kayyeyma netiru, ella bealma illaa.

Ta chaze, tichla demashkena, kolla kayyeyma beraza illaa, veukemuha. techelet veargaman chad, leitkashshera bechad. veha ittemar beraza dichtiv, (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu. veha ittemar deit eshsha ochla eshsha, veachil leh veshatze leh. begin deit eshsha takkifa meeshsha.

(Man devae leminda chachmeta beyichuda kaddisha vechulei. mikkan ad dekayyeyma aleh befarashat Bereshit daf nusach acher 370. veellu hacheylevapeym matzanu ben hakkatuv kan leven hakkatuv sham. shura 1 bemakom gassa matzanu achara. besora 2 deitteachid beh. besora 11 leadlaka uleitachada beh. besora 12 shetze leh veachil leh. besora 23 veal nehora chivvavra sharyay leella nehora setima deakif leh raza ilaa hacha vecholla tishkach. besora 33 kolla itchabbar. besora 34 beh letatta. besora 35 desalik. besora 4 veihu. besora Adonai deihu dalik. shura 6 vecholla itkeshar. shura 10 al tarebayn. shura 14 vechullehu kayyme 408. shura 15 milla achara letatta. shura 16 velet lecha. 0). (Shemot 38:28) veet haelef usheva hammeot vachamishsha veshivim asa vavim laammudim vetzippa rashehem vegomer. ta chaze, olifna deinnun tekalin anshe lon moshe, vela yada ma deitavid minnayyhu, ad denafak kala veamar, veet haelef usheva hammeot vachamishsha veshivim asa vavim laammudim.

Ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 1:12) ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi natan recho. hay kera ittemar, aval ad shehammelech bimsibbo, da kudesha berich hu, kad yahav orayyta leyisrael, veata lesinay. vechamma retichin havo immeh, kullehu retichin kadishin, vechol kiddushin illain, dikdushsha deorayyta, kullehu havo tamman, veorayyta ityeyhivat belahate eshsha, vecholla besitra deeshsha, uchetiva beeshsha chivvavra, al gabbe eshsha uchama. veatvavn havo parchin vesallekin baavira.
Veat kadmaa deorayyta, itpelig lishva mea veshivim vachamishsha lechol setar, vechullehu itchazun baavira dirkia beat 6, 6 lesitra da, 6 lesitra da. vechen lechol sitrin.

Veillen vavin havo kayymin al ammudin, veinnun ammudin havo kayymin al nisa, vechullehu vavin alayyhu. begin deraza deorayyta al vav kayyeyma. veinnun vavin deinnun raza (Bereshit 52) dimhemnuta deorayyta, kullehu al innun ammudim kayymin, deinnun razin denafkin behu neviim, raza dilhon bechol setar. veal innun kayymin, kayyman innun vavin.

6 Illaa, ihu raza dekol deishtema, veihu raza dekayyeyma beh orayyta, begin deorayyta nafka mehahu kala penimaa, deikre kol gadol. veda kol gadol ihu raza deorayyta. veal da ketiv (Devarim Adonai:19) kol gadol velo yasaf.

Ta chaze, hay kol gadol, ihu ikkara decholla, veraza dishma kaddisha illaa, veal da ukemuha, deasir leh levar nash leakdema shelama lechavreh, ad la yitzle tzeloteh. veraza da ukemuha, dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:14) mevarech (182 amud alef) reehu bekol gadol babboker hashekem kelala techashev lo. velav ihu asur, ad dimvarech leh beraza dekol gadol, deihu ikara dishma kaddisha.
Veal da, raza deorayyta nafka mehahu kol gadol, veda ihu melech. bimsibbo: da maamad har sinay, veukemuha nirdi natan
951: Recho, da keneset yisrael. begin deamru yisrael, (Shemot 24:7) kol asher dibber Adonai naase venishma. shehammelech: da ihu melech illaa, veukemuha.

Ta chaze, kad kudesha berich hu ayyte tofana al alma, begin lechabbela kolla, amar leh kudesha berich hu lenoach, bae lach (sefer acher laasatetarea) leistammera, vela tachaziyi garmach kammeh dimchabbela, dela yishlot alach, begin dela hava man deyagin aloy. kevan deitkeriv karbena, dekariv noach, keden itbesam alma, vela itbesam kule hay ad dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay. kevan dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay, keden itbesam alma, umechabbela la ishtechach bealma.

Uvaa kudesha berich hu behahu zimna, leabera hahu mechabbela mealma, (vechad) bar deyisrael sarchu behahu zimna, leyomin zeirin, veavdu yat egla. ucheden ma ketiv, (Shemot 33:6) vayyitnatztzelu veni yisrael et edyam mehar chorev. veedyam hava razin dishma (Bereshit 52 amud bet) kaddisha, deatar lon kudesha berich hu, veitnetal minnayyhu, keden shalta mechabbela al alma, veahdar kemillekaddemin, kehahu zimna deshalta bealma, veavid dina.

Amar ribbi yose, beyomoy detofana, man yahiv tamman mechabbela, deha mayya havo deitgabbaru, ta chaze, let lacha dina bealma, o kad itmeche alma bedina, dela ishtechach (196 amud alef) hahu mechabbela benayyhu, deazil bego innun dinin deitavedu bealma. uf hacha, tofana hava, umechabbela azil bego tofana, veihu ikre hachi. veal da amar leh kudesha berich hu lenoach, letammera garmeh, vela yitchaze bealma. veha ukemuha. <small>ta chaze, amar ribbi yose la ityayshav alma vela nafkat ara mizzohama vechulei. amar rabbi yose la ityayshav alma vela nafkat ara umizohama vechulei. ad kach yisrael im kudesha berich hu. befarashat noach daf 63 2 70 1 uv veellu hacheylevapeym matzanu ben hakkatuv kan leven hakkatuv sham. daf 63 2 shura 24. letatta veihu amshich leh lealma levatar dichtiv vayyesht min hayyayin vayishkar vayitgal veha itmar. shura 28 alma 120 al maya. shura 31 amar lan. shura 37 120 verosh hashshana shura 8 veraza chada. shura 13 bediyyukena deshayyfe. shura 14 name ihu. shura 26 diltatta. shura Adonai dealma uveod deihu bilchodoy im malka shail leh kol tzarchoy veyahiv leh. (uchevar nitkan hakkol banevasechaa ameyteyt - 507)</small>

Ta chaze, amar ribbi elazar, veet haelef usheva hammeot vachamishsha veshivim asa vavim laammudim. amay vavim. ella kemin vav havo, vereshehon chafa bedahava. innun dechesef, vereshehon mechafan bedahava, begin dechol vav besitra derachame ka atya, vechullehu havo ishtemodan leella bechushebana. uvegin deatu missitra derachame, havo ikrun vavim. vechol shear talyayn behu. velet vav ella dahava vechasfa kachada. uvegin kach, kol innun ikrun, vavi deinnun ammudim. man ammudim. kema deat amer vehaammudim shenayim vegomer. begin deha illen levar migufa, letata havo kayymin.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, la yedana i da avidta dekodesh, o chol. begin dichtiv veet haelef, deha ketiv hacha haelef, uchetiv hatam (Shir HaShirim 8:12) haelef lecha shelomo, ma lehallan haelef chol, uf hacha haelef chol.

Amar leh, lav hachi, dei hu hava chol, la yitavid minnayyhu vavim. vetu, deha tamman ketiv haelef vela yatir, vehacha ketiv haelef usheva hammeot vachamishsha veshivim. haelef dehatam innun chol, dichtiv haelef lecha shelomo. veda ihu chol, begin dechol chol lav ihu besitra dikdushsha kelal. chol ihu missitra achara mesaava. veal da havedala ben kodesh lechol, begin devaenan leafresha ben kodesh lechol. veraza dikra hachi hu, (Vayikra 10:10) ulahavdil ben hakkodesh uven hachol uven hattame uven hattahor.
Veim kol da af al gav difrishu it lakodesh min hachol, chulaka chada it leh bikdushsha
952: Missitra dismala. hada hu dichtiv haelef lecha shelomo, deinnun elef yome hachol. veinnun yome degaluta. kema deit elef yomin dikdushsha, hachi name elef yomin lesitra achara. veal da itaru chavrayyay, innun yomin degaluta, elef shenin havo.

Veal da, it elef veit elef, veinnun elef shenin degaluta, af al gav deyisrael yehon begaluta, veyitmashshechun yatir, behane elef shenin yitmashshechun, deinnun elef yomin dekaamaran. uvegin da okmuha, kol shelomo deit beshir hashshirim kodesh, bar mehay deihu chol. haelef dehacha, kodesh ihu, vechol ovadoy kodesh, veal da asa vavim laammudim.

Ta chaze, ha amaran kol 6 beraza derachame ihu, vechol atar deate 6 bishma kadisha, rachame ihu. (nidpas 58 64 amud bet) kegon (Bereshit 19:24) vaAdonai himtir al sedom. (Bereshit 13) vaAdonai amar el avram. rachame vedina kachada. demay shena betofna, dichtiv elohim bechol atar, amay la ketiv vaAdonai. ella tanenan, bechol atar dichtiv vaAdonai, hu uvet dino. elohim setam, dina bilchodoy.

Ella bisdom, itavid dina, vela leshetzaa alma. uvegin kach itarav ihu bahade dina. aval betofna, kol alma shetze, vechol innun deishtechachu bealma. vei tema, deha noach udeimmeh ishtezivu. ha satim meena hava, dela itchaze. veal da kol ma deishtechach bealma shetze leh.

Veal da vaAdonai beitgalyay, vela shetze kolla. elohim satim, uvae leistammera, deha kolla shetze. veal da elohim bilchodoy hava, veraza da (Tehillim 29:10) Adonai lammabbul yashav. mahu yashav. ilmale kera ketiv, la yachlenan lememar. yashav yashav bilchodoy, dela ata im dina. ketiv hacha yashav, uchetiv hatam (Vayikra 13:46) badad yeshev bilchodoy.

Veraza olifna, kudesha berich hu satim vegalya. galya hu be dina letata. satim hu atar dechol birchan nafke mitamman, begin kach, kol milloy devar nash deinnun bistimu, birchan sharyayn aleh vechol deinnun beitgalyay, hahu atar deve dina sharya aloy, begin deihu atar beitgalyay. vecholla ihu beraza illaa, kegavvna dilella.

(Ad kan) (Shir HaShirim 1:12) ad shehammelech bimsivo, behahu chavruta vetafnuka deeden illaa, (ha ukemuha deha) behahu shevil desatim veganiz vela ityeyda, veitmalleya minneh, venafkin benachalin yedian. (Vayikra sefer acher amud alef) nirdi natan recho, da yam batraa, devara alma tattaa, kegavvna dilella, vesalik recha tava illaa, leshalletaa ulemebad, veyachil veshalit venahir binhora illaa.

Ta chaze, beshaata dehay nirda salleka recha leella, keden chevivuta itkashsherat, vesalleka hay nirda leitachada leella. vechullehu retichin kaddishin, kullehu sallekin rechin leitattera legabbe dilella. innun retichin kullehu ikrun alamot shir, kema deat amer (Tehillim 46:1) al alamot shir, veha ukemuha. may alamot shir. ella kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 6:8) vaalamot en mispar. may vaalamot en mispar. kema deat amer (Iyov 25:3) hayesh mispar ligdudav. uvegin delet lehu chushebana ketiv vaalamot en mispar.

(Shemot 38:28) vavim laammudim, kullehu dechurin. kol innun desallekin birvu meshach leella, kullehu kayymin beraza didchurin, vela ikre dechar ella 6, raza dishmaya, deinnun dechurin. vechol innun diltatta, ikrun nukeve. uvegin kach kol innun deatyayn missitra dismala, missitra denukeba, itmanan al hashshir, veamre shirata tadir. veal da ketiv, al alamot shir. vechullehu nafku beraza de. Adonai appikat kama chelin lezinnayyhu beraza dev. 6, da raza didchura dekayyeyma lemehav mezona lenukeba.

Uvegin kach, kol innun vavin aved betzalel, lemehav lon leashraa al nukeve. venafke meraza deelef, deihu chusheban shelim. usheva meot, deihu raza shelim. vachamishsha hachi name. veshivim kolla raza chada. veal da, meraza dena, vechusheban da, asa vavim. vechullehu beraza dev, uvediukena dev itavidu, vecholla beraza illaa, uvechushebna natle.
953: (Shemot 38:29) unechoshet hattenufa shivim kikkar, amar ribbi yehuda, kol da nachta letatta, bediyyukena illaa deraza dimhemnuta. kegavvna da avad (Daniel 3) nevuchadnetzar harasha hahu tzalma deatkin. amar ribbi yose, ihu la avid hachi, aval bechelmeh chama hachi, deha bechelmeh chama, (Daniel 2:34) resha di dahava, ulevatar kaspa, ulevatar nechasha. vei tema parzela vechaspa amay lav hachi. begin delav innun keday leaala lekudesha, veillen telata acharanin alu.
Veraza dileh demashkena, bitlat telat beillen mattechan. uvishara arba, kegon techelet veargaman vetolaat shani vashesh. uchegon arbaa tvviri even.

Amar ribbi yehuda, minnehon bitlat. minnehon bed. minnehon bitren. minnehon bechad. aval kol sidra vesidra lav ihu ella bitlat. (vayyetze 159 amud alef) telat sidrin innun demitparshin lechol setar, learba sitre alma, vechol sidra vesidra deihu lechol setar, telat sidrin innun. veokimna.

Sidra kadmaa delistar mizrach, telat sidrin innun veinnun tisha sidrin, begin dechol sidra meinnun 3, it leh telat sidrin, veishtechachu deinnun tisha. vechamma elef verivvan techotayyhu. vehani sidrin tisha, kullehu mitnahage beatvavn reshiman. vechol sidra isteche leinnun atvavn reshiman, veha ukemuha. vechen lechol sidra vesidra, vechullehu natle beatvavn reshiman. veillen illae meillen, vekayyman illen al illen. (nusach acher umitchabberan kullehu veamri shirata)

Vechad innun atvavn parchin, go avira derucha, hahu dimmana al kolla, keden kullehu natle, (nusach acher vasheyretaa itbesam) veha ukemuha. vechad at batash mittatta, vehahu at salleka venachta, uteren atvavn parche ale. vehay at mittatta, salleka mittatta leella, veitchabbar behu, veitavidu telat atvavn, kullehu lefum atvavn 20, deinnun telat go aspakalarya denahara. meillen itperashu telat sidrin. veinnun atvavn teren, vehahu at desalleka mitchabbera immehon, veinnun telat.

Ta chaze, innun teren atvavn illain desallekin baavira, innun kelilan da beda, rachame vedina, uvegin kach innun teren, veinnun mealma dilella. beraza didchura. vehay desalleka umitchabbera immehon, ihi nukeba, veitkelilat betarvavyyhu.

Kegavvna denukeba itkelilat bitren sitrin, bimina usemala, veitchabbarat behu. hachi name, hay at nukeba, veitchabbarat bitren atvavn acharanin, veinnun bitren sitrin, illen illain, veillen tattain, vecholla ihu chad, dechar venukeba.
Dechad itbere alma, innun atvavn mealma illaa ninhu, deinnun olidu kol ovadin letatta, kegavvna dilhon mammash. begin kach, man deyada lon, veizdehir behu, rachim leella rachim letatta.

Ribbi shimon amar, illen atvavn kullehu dechar venukeba, leitkallela kachada, beraza demayin illain umayin tattain, vecholla chad, veda hu yichuda shelim. veal da, man deyada lon, veizdehar behu, zakkaa ihu behay alma, vezakkaa ihu bealma deate. begin deihu ikara deyichuda shelim kadka chaze. telat telat missitra da umissitra da, beyichuda chada, bishlimu decholla. vechullehu raza desidra illaa kadka chaze kegavvna dilella, dehahu sidra telat telat beraza chada.

Sidra tinyayna delistar darom, (deihu raza dichsaf) telat sidrin innun lehahu sitra. vechol sidra vesidra telat telat, veinnun 9, kema deittemar. veatvavn itpelagu hachi lechol sitre, leitchabbera kolla bechad, begin deit atvavn beraza denukeba, veatvavn beraza didchura, veitchabbaru kullehu kachada, vahavu chad, beraza dishma kaddisha shelim. ulegabbayyhu sidrin memanan, telat telat, kema deittemar. vecholla nafka missidra daavahan dilella kesidra
954: Deittaknan atvavn dishma kaddisha 20, kema deittemar. hane sidrin kullehu, mitnahage beillen atvavn yedian, venatle behu. vechamma chelin veravrevan, kullehu letatta, denatle veitnahage besidra da.
Sidra telitaa delistar tzafon, bitlat sidrin innun lehahu sitra, veinnun tisha. uvitlat sitrin telat telat lechol setar, veinnun tisha. veinnun sidrin mittelat sitrin kema deittemar.

Shiva veesrin beraza deatvavn, deinnun shiva veesrin. veaf al gav deinnun teren veesrim, shelimu deatvavn shiva veesrin innun. veishtechachu, kema deatvavn 27, hachi siddura desidrin illen, shiva veesrin, litlat telat sidrin lechol setar. veishtechachu illen telat dehay sitra deinnun 9. veillen telat dehay sitra deinnun 9. veillen telat dehay sitra deinnun tisha. ishtechachu kullehu leshiva veesrin.
Veraza deillen shiva veesrin, innun 9 atvavn deinnun beraza denukeba, leitchabbera im innun tamnesar acharanin beraza didchar, vecholla ihu kadka chaze.

Ta chaze, kegavvna deatvavn illain dealma illaa, hachi name atvavn acharanin letatta. atvavn illain ravrevin, (hakedama 3 amud bet) veatvavn tattain zeirin. vecholla da kegavvna da. vechol hani razin beraza didchar venukeba kolla chad bishlimu. veal da kolla ihu beraza illaa. (ad kan)
(Nidpas Bereshit 21 amud bet) bearbein vechamesh zine gevavni nehorin itpelig alma.

Shiva mitpalgin leshiva tehomin. kol chad batash bithoma dileh, veavnin mitgalgelan bego tehoma, veayil hahu nehora, beinnun avanin, venakiv lon, umayin nafkin behu. veshakin kol chad vechad al tehoma, vechafya litren sitrin.
Nafke mayya beinnun nukevin, veal nehora, uvatash learba sitre tehoma, mitgalgela nehora bachaverteh, veiarau bechad, ufalgin mayya.

Veachidan kol innun shiva, beshiva tehome, vecharan bachashoche tehome, vachashoche innun mitarve behu. sallekin mayin, venachtin mitgalgelan beinnun nehorin, veitarvan kachada, nehorin vachashochin umayin, veitavidu minnayyhu nehorin dela itchazyayn chashochan.
Batash kol chad bechavreh, umitpalgin leshivin vechamesh tzinnore tehomin uvehu nagdin mayya.

Kol tzinnora vetzinnora salik bekaleh, veizdazean tehomin. vechad hahu kala ishtema, kol tehoma kare lechavreh, veamar palig memach, veeul bach, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:8) tehom el tehom kore lekol tzinnorecha.

Techot illen, telat mea veshittin vechamesh gidin, minnehon chivvavrin, minnehon uchamin, minnehon sumakin, itkelilan da beda, veitavidu gon chad. innun gidin itrekimu besheva esre reshatot, vechol chad reshet gidin ikre. itrekimu da beda, venachtin beshippule tehoma. techot illen, teren reshatin kayymin bechezu defarzela, uteren reshatin acharanin bechezu dinchasha.

Teren kuresvavn kayyme alayyhu, chad mimina, vechad missemala. kol innun reshatin mitchabberan kachada, umayin nachtin meinnun tzinnorin, vealin beillen reshatin. innun teren kuresvavn, chad kuresayyay dirkia uchama, vechad kuresayay dirkia sasgona. illen teren kuresvavn, kad innun sallekin, sallekin behahu kuresyay (243 amud bet) dirkia uchama. vechad nachtin, nachtin behahu kuresyay dirkia sasgona.

Illen teren kuresvavn, chad mimina vechad missemala. hahu kuresyay dirkia uchama mimina. vehahu kuresyay dirkia sasgona missemala. kad salkin bechuresyay dirkia uchama. maich kuresyay dirkia semala venachtin beh.
Mitgalgelan kuresvavn chad bechad. naktin kol innun reshatin begavavyyhu, vealin lon beshippule dithoma tattaa.
Kaim chad kuresyay, vesalik leella mikkol innun tehome, vekaim kuresyay achara, letatta dechol tehome.
955: Ben teren kursevavn illen mitgalgelan kol innun tehome, vechol innun tzinnorin, itneitzu ben teren kursevavn illen.

Shivin vechamesh tzinnorin innun, shiva innun illae decholla. vechol innun acharanin achidan behu, vechullehu neitzin begalgeloy dehay kuresyay besitra da, uneitzin begalgeloy dehay kuresyay besitra da.

Behu, mayin (batehavemaa) sallekin venachtin, innun denachte karan battehome, uvake lon. innun desallekin alin beinnun nukeve avanin, vesallekin umalyayn leshiva yamim. ad kan shiva gevavne nehorin beraza illaa. (ad kan).

Ta chaze, nechoshet hattenufa deka amaran, illen innun (233 amud alef) ture nechoshet, deikrun hare nechoshet. veinnun deikrun adne nechoshet. (veillen) kayymin tarin, bechol innun pitchin, vesacharin lehu, lechol innun dekayymin lego, begin deillen innun tarin dekayymin lefitchin levar, veillen alin venafke beve malka.

Umin nechoshet da, kol innun manin demadbecha leshammesha bah. veillen innun manin lemadbecha, dechad nishmatin mitkarvin lesalleka al gabbe madbecha, illen innun palchin hahu pulechana demadbecha, vechullehu mesayyeye leshammesha hahu shimmusha, veikrun kele hammizbeach. vechol illen manin, vechol innun yetedot hammishkan, kullehu bishmahan ikrun, mani deshimmusha leshammesha bekudesha. veal da kayymin kullehu memanan yedian, uretichin yedian, veruchin yedian, kol chad vechad kadka chaze leh. uvehechalin dekudesha deinnun hechalin yedian, kullehu bechushebana.

Kishshura dedahava bedahava. kaspa bechaspa. nechasha binchasha. illen dinchoshet diltatta, natle chela minnechoshet dilella, vechen kolla. kol innun gavvnin mitarve illen beillen, leachada leitkashshera illen beillen.

Karse zahav innun kayymin lekashshera innun yerian chad bechad. karse nechoshet innun kayyeyman lekashshera mashkena. veillen lokovel illen. vechullehu kayymin kechochavayya (232 amud bet) illen birkia, kema dinhirin kochavaya birkia veitchazun, hachi name nehirin innun kerasim bemashkena. veha okimna. unehirin innun kerasim veitchazun, kechochavayya dekayyme uvalte venatztze. (nusach acher valehatey) veinnun chamshin dedahava, vechamshin dinchasha, venaharin illen lokovel illen.

Miggo nehora dilella, nafak chad netzitzu denatzitz, veanhir bego aspakalarya dela nahara, vehahu netzitzu kalil mikkol gavvnin dinhirin, veikre argaman. vechad batash hay argaman behahu nehora chashocha (sefer acher tichla), keden nafak chad netzitzu achara dela lahit, veitarvu da beda. veinnun havo levushin dekudesha, deitlabbash behu michael kahana rabba.

Vechad itlebash behu beinnun levushe yekar, keden al leshammesha bekudesha, vead la levish bemalbushin illen, lo al lekudesha. kegavvna da, (Shemot 24:18) vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el hahar, (99 amud alef) veolifna dehava mitlabbash baanana. vechad hava mitlabbash baanana, keden vayyaal el hahar. vead la itlabbash beh, la yachil lemeal lego. kegavvna da kahana rabba, la al lekudesha, ad deitlabbash beillen levushin, begin leaala lekudesha.

Uvegin denafku merazin illain, veinnun kegavvna dilella, ikrun bigde serad. begin deishtearu meinnun levushin illain, begin dahavo mimma deishtear minhorin dezivin illain. techelet veargaman, gavvnin deraza dishma kaddisha, deikre shema (Bereshit 48 amud bet) shelim, Adonai elohim. veda ihu raza, leitlabbesha kahana rabba, lemeal lekudesha. tolaat shani innun gavvnin sumaka, vetichla veargevavna, deihu kalil bechol innun gavvnin. umiggo deihu itlabbash behu bilvushin digvavnin illen, hava al lego vela dachyayn leh levar.

Ta chaze, kolla itavid beraza dimhemnuta, lemehve kolla kegavvna dilella. veal da ketiv, bigde hasserad lesharet bakkodesh. veikrun bigde (kodesh) serad begin dela ikrun kodesh, ella kad sharan beh innun gavvnin. dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:4) bigde
956: Kodesh hem. uchetiv (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai rishit tevuato. kodesh yisrael: begin divyisrael itchazun kol gavvnin. kohanim ulevviyim veyisrael. veillen innun gavvnin leitchazaa lego.

Ta chaze, (58 2, 231 amud alef) nishmeta la salleka leitchazaa kame malka kaddisha, ad dezachat leitlabbesha bilvusha dilella leitchazaa tamman. vechen kegavvna da la nachta letatta, ad deitlabbeshat bilvusha dehay (150 amud alef) alma.

Kegavvna da malachin kaddishin dilella, dichtiv behu (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot meshartav esh lohet. kad avdin (231 amud alef) shelichuta behay alma, la nachtin letatta, ad demitlabbeshin bilvusha dehay alma. vecholla ihu kegavvna dehahu atar deazil tamman. veha okimna, denishmeta la salleka, ella bilvusha denahir.

Veta chaze, adam harishon kad hava beginta deeden, hava mitlabbash bilvusha kegavvna dilella, veihu levusha dinhora illaa. kevan deittarach migginta deeden, veitzterich ligvavnin dehay alma, ma ketiv (Bereshit 3:21) vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam uleishto katnot or vayyalbishem. bekadmita havo katnot or, or, dehahu nehora illaa, deshimmesh beh began eden.

Begin deha ginta deeden, nehora illaa denahir meshammesh beh. veal da, adam kadmaa kad al lego ginta, albish leh kudesha berich hu bilvusha dehahu nehora, veail leh tamman. vei la itlabbash bekadmita behahu nehora, la yeul letaman. kevan deittarach mittamman, itzterich lemalbusha achara, keden, vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam uleishto katnot or. vecholla kema deitzterich. vehacha kegavvna da, asu bigde serad lesharet bakkodesh, leaala bekudesha.

Veha (2 amud alef) ukemuha, deovadin tavin devar nash deavid behay alma, innun ovadin mashche minnehora deziva illaa, levusha, leittakna beh lehahu alma, leitchazaa kame kudesha berich hu. uvehahu levusha delavish, ithane vechame go aspakalarya denahara, kema deat amer (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo.

Veal da, nishmeta itlabbeshat bitren almin, lemeheve lah shelimu becholla, behay alma diltatta, uvealma dilella. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha. ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha behay alma, yeshvu yesharim et panecha behahu alma.

(Shemot 39:2) vayyaas et haefod zahav, ha ukemuha. amar ribbi yose, efod vechoshen kachada havo, veukemuha deha baatar dehu kiuma, kayyman kol innun teresar avanin, kullehu natle shemahan bene yisrael, vechullehu teresar techumin illain, kullehu beraza deshivte yisrael innun.

Veraza da ketiv, (Tehillim 122:4) sheshsham alu shevatim shivte yah edut leyisrael lehodot leshem Adonai. sheshsham alu shevatim, illen innun teresar shevatin illain leella, deinnun shivte yah, deha shema da edut leyisrael.

Amar ribbi chiyay, tere zimne ketiv shevatim. ella, sheshsham alu shevatim, illen shevatin diltatta. shivte yah, illen shevatin dilella. edut leyisrael, da raza (221 amud bet) dishma kaddisha illaa da, deikre edut, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 132:12) veedoti zo alammedem. veinnun teresar shevatin kaddishin illain, innun teresar avanin kaddishin. veal da innun kayymin letatta, kegavvna dilella, vechol innun shemahan ditresar shevatin, kullehu gelifan beinnun avanin, vechahana rabba natil lon.

Ta chaze, yaakov kad hava azil lecharan, ma ketiv (Bereshit 28:11) vayyikkach meavne hammakom vayyasem meraashotav. illen teresar avanin kaddishin, vechullehu itavidu chad avna, dichtiv vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva. vekare lehu even, may taama. begin dechullehu teresar avanin, itkelilu beavna chad kaddisha illaa, deihi leella minnehon, dichtiv vehaeven hazzot
957: Asher samti matzeva yihye bet elohim.

Veal da hacha, kahana rabba shavve lon al libbeh, ledachra lehon tadir, dichtiv, (Shemot 28:30) venasa aharon et shemot bene yisrael al libbo lifne Adonai tamid. uvegin kach, kolla ihu beraza ditresar, (mikketz 199 amud alef) teresar illain temirin leella, deitgenizu beraza illaa kaddisha, veinnun raza deorayyta, venafke mikkol chad dakik veha ukemuha. teresar acharanin temirin letatta, kegavvna dilhon, venafke go kala achara, deihi even dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:24) misham roe even yisrael.

Veal da ukemuha beraza dikra dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:3) veneesafu shamma chol haadarim vegallu et haeven. da shechinta, deikre even bochan, even yisrael. dimganderin lah, vealin lah begaluta, uchetiv veheshivu et haeven al pi habbeer limkomah, veal shemah ikrun kullehu avanin.

Vechamma avanin laavanin. it avanin veit avanin, it avanin yesode beta, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 Adonai:31) vaytzav hammelech vayassiu avanim gedolot avanim yekarot leyassed habbayit avni gazit. veit avanin illain yakkirin, veinnun (illen) teresar. veinnun arba sidrin, telata telata lechol sidra, learba ruche alma. kegavvna da innun arba degalim, dahavo azle bemadbera, veinnun teresar shevatin, telata telata lechol sitra, learba ruche alma. vecholla raza chada veha ukemuha.

Veta chaze, beshaata dechahana rabba hava shavve illen teresar avanin, velavish lon bechoshna veefoda, keden sharya aleh shechinta. veinnun teresar avanin, gelifin bishmahan dechullehu shevatin. vechol shivta veshivta itgelif al avna chad. meshakkean havo atvavn al avanin. vechad nehirin avanin, atvavn havo baltin levar, venaharin al ma deitzterichu.

(Uveatvavn deshivtin) uvishvatin kullehu, la havo teren (152 amud alef) atvavn 8 9, begin dela ishtechach chova bechullehu. amar ribbi chizkiyya, i hachi 8 dishma garim yeot. aval 9, deihi at tav, vetanenan man dechame at 9 bechelmeh, tav leh, begin deveh patcha orayyta ki tov. dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov, vehoil vehi at tav, amay la ichtuv beinnun shevatin.

Amar leh, begin desamychin teren atvavn ahadade. vetu, deha at 9 ganiz vetamir. veihu nahir nehiru dechullehu, deha at da nehiru dechullehu have. velav nehiru ishtechach bar meat da, dichtiv vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. vehu nehiru dehahu nehora deganiz vetamir. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 84:12) lo yimna tov laholchim betamim. veda ihu nehora dechullehu shevatin. uvegin kach la itgelaf behu. vetu, dechullehu teresar nafke miggo achsadra da temira, deihi beraza deat 9, uvegin kach ihu tamir veganiz, vela itchaze behu.

Ta chaze, kol hani avanin, kayyme beorach at venisa. vechullehu kad havo naharin, keden kahana rabba havo nehirin anpoy, veatvavn nehirin uvaltin leishtemoda levar. vechad havo naharin anpoy dechahana keden havo ishtemodan belitu deatvavn, deihu letav. uveda ishtemoda kahana, i zakkaa hu i lav. veal da kolla ihu beat venisa, veha ukemuha.

Ribbi abba hava shechiach kammeh deribbi shimon, amar leh, ha dichtiv, (Shemot 28:30) venatatta el choshen hammishpat et haurim veet hattummim, vetanenan, urim: denaharin bemilla deitzterichu. tumim: deashlimu bemillayyhu. tu anan tzerichin leminda. (hay raza)

Amar leh, vadday, vehachi ihu, choshen veefod lokovel urim vetumim. veda raza, ditfillin, vekishra ditfillin, lokovel teren illen. patach veamar (Shemot 33:23) veraita et achoray ufanay lo yerau. veraita et achoray, ha tanenan, deachze leh kudesha berich hu lemoshe, kesher shel tefillin. ufanay: illen tefillin mammash. ufanay innun tefillin, deinnun raza illaa shema kaddisha.
958: Achoray, ihu raza dekishra ditfilin. veha yedia legabbe chavrayyay. begin deda aspakalarya denahara. veda ihi aspakalarya dela nahara.

Lokovel da, urim: denaharin bemillayyhu. tumim: deashlimu bemillayyhu. da panim. veda achor. veraza da kol vedibbur. kol anhir ledibbur, lemallela. dibbur ashlim milla. vetadir da beda salkan, vela (hakedama 7 amud bet) itparshan da min da lealmin, uvegin kach, choshen veefod, da panim veda achor vecholla raza chada bela perishu kelal.

Amar leh, i hachi dela mitparshan lealmin, uman deafrish lon, ha tanenan, dichtiv, (Mishlei 16:28) mafrid alluf, mahu dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 23:6) vayhi bivroach evyatar ben achimelech el david keila efod yarad beyado, veillu choshen la kaamar.

Amar leh, vadday hachi hu, kol ma dehu chashiv, ihu tamir veganiz, vela idkar kol kach. kegavvna da nose efod bad, ma deihu beitgalyay yattir, ihu adkar, begin deyitkasse ma deihu bignizu utemiru. veal da adkar ma deihu beitgalyay yattir.

Uvegin kach, shema illaa ihu raza bitmiru ugenizu, vela adkar ella bishma deihu beitgalyay. da adkar, veda agniz. da beitgalyay, veda bistiru, vechol ma deitgalyay ihu adkar lealmin. shema deganiz ihu Adonai, shema deihu beitgalyay ihu adonay, veal da ichtuv beatvavn temirin, veikre beatvavn illen, veitkasse da beda, lemehve yekara illaa tamir veganiz lealmin. dechol (99 amud alef) orche deorayyta hachi hu, itgalyay usetima. vechol millin dealma ben dealma den, uven dealma dilella, kullehu ihu tamir vegalya.

Patach veamar, (Yona 1:8) vayyomru elav haggida na lanu baasher lemi haraa hazzot lanu vegomer. hay kera it leistakkela beh, kullehu beraza dechachmeta shailu. dichtiv haggida na lanu baasher lemi, baasher, raza dechachmeta shailu. hacha shailu raza deihu beitgalyay, leminda i mizzara deyosef kaate, deyamma kevan dechama arona dileh, miyyad itbeka, vahava yabbeshta, dichtiv (Tehillim 114:3) hayyam raa vayyanos, hayyam raa, hahu dichtiv beh (Bereshit 39:12) vayanas vayyetze hachutza. miyyad hayyarden yissov leachor.

Veal da shailu leh baasher, dichtiv beh beyosef, (Bereshit 39:9) baasher at ishto. i mehahu zara ka atit, tzalle deyishtok yamma minan. lemi, vei mizzara deyaakov ka atit, dichtiv beh, (Bereshit 32:18) lemi atta veana telech, veinnun havo malachin kaddishin, deshadar bishlichuteh, veishteziv mehahu aku. tzalle lemarach, vishader malacheh, venishteziv mehahu aku.

Vei lav, ma melachtecha, bema ishtadlutach bechol yoma. umeayin tavo, man innun avahatach. ma artzecha, i hi ara deitchazyay leitannesha. vei mizze am atta, i hu amalek, o chad mishshiva ammin, deitchazun leitannesha. kolla shailu leh kedka yeot.

Ma ativ lon, vayyomer alehem ivri anochi, mehahu zara deavraham haivri, deakdish shema demareh bechol yoma bealma. veet Adonai elohe hashshamayim ani yare vegomer, innun la shailu leh ella milla beitgalya uveitkasya leminda beh. veihu ativ lon kolla beitgalya.

Ma ketiv vayyiru haanashim yira gedola, kevan deshamu shema dekudesha berich hu, miyyad dachilu, begin dechullehu havo yadin nissin ugevuran deavad kudesha berich hu beyamma, vechevan deamar lon shema dekudesha berich hu, miyyad dachilu kammeh dechilu sagi. tu amar lon, deihu arak mikkame kudesha berich hu. veal da amru leh, ma zot asita, deant arkat mikkammeh, vela avdat pikkodoy. uvegin kach ma zot asita deant avarta al pikkude demarach.
Veta chaze, kol illen itgayyayru levatar, kad chamu nissin ugevuran deavad leh kudesha berich hu leyona beyamma. vechullehu chamu leh kad nafal beyamma,
959: Vehahu nuna desalik uvala leh kammayyhu. vechad ata hahu nuna rabba leenehon decholla, ufalat leh leyabbeshta, atu legabbeh veitgayyeyru kullehu. hada hu dichtiv, (Yona 2:9) meshammerim havele shav chasdam yaazovu.

Veta chaze, kullehu illen havo gere tzedek, veitchakkamu beorayyta, vahavu chakkimin illain, begin deha kudesha berich hu itree behu, uvechol innun demikreve legabbeh, umekaddeshin shemeh beitgalya dechad itkaddash shemeh beitgalya, shemeh deitkasseya, istelik al kurese yekareh, dichtiv, (Vayikra 22:32) venikdashti betoch bene yisrael.

(401 Chaze ma ketiv) (Shemot 39:21) vayyirkesu et hachoshen mittabbeotav el tabbeot haefod biftil techelet. amay biftil techelet. ella leachazaa behay (235 amud bet) techela itkashar becholla. veal da kolla ihu beraza illaa.

Ma ketiv, paamon zahav verimmon, veokimna, vecholla ihu beraza illaa kidkaamran. ma ketiv, venishma kolo bevoo el hakkodesh lifne Adonai. begin deitzterich (Bereshit 50 amud bet) kala deishtema, uvirkan yishrun al alma begineh dechahana, deihu mevarech kolla, ufalach kolla. paamon zahav, ha okimna. rimmon, deitmalleyay kerimona da, deihu itmalyay mikkolla, vecholla okimna.

(Shemot 39:22) vayyaas et meil haefod maase oreg kelil techelet. ha ittemar beraza dechoshen veefod, vecholla chad. kelil techelet, dehachi itchaze kema deokimna, detichla ihu raza dinhora dechuresyay tichla. deihu bekishshura dinhiru (Bereshit nusach acher amud alef) chivvavra, kolla kachada. veal da tichla leefoda ihu.

Amar ribbi shimon, hane mani dilvushin dechahana, kullehu beraza illaa ihu, lemehve levushin diltatta, kegavvna dilella. ta chaze, kevan demichael kahana rabba ihu, veate missitra dimina, amay ketiv begavriel, (Daniel 12:7) haish levush habbaddim, deha levushin lechahana rabba ihu, umichael ihu kahana, veate missitra dimina. ella mehacha, dismala itkelil bimina tadir, veitlabbash gavriel (233 amud alef) bilvushin illen.

Tu, deha gavriel ihu itmanna shelicha behay alma, vechol shelicha deitmanna behay alma, itzterich leitlabbesha bilvushin dehay alma, veha okimna beraza denishmeta, kad salkat leella itlabbeshat bilvusha kegavvna dilella, begin lemeheve tamman. vechen kad nachtat letatta milleella, kolla ihu kegavvna dehahu atar deazlat tamman. kegavvna da kol innun shelichan deitmenan bishlichuta behay alma, veha (229 amud bet) okimna.
Veta chaze, hay meila deefoda, lechafya aleh, kad lavish leh. ketiv (Tehillim 139:5) achor vakedem tzartani vattashet alay kappecha. hay kera ha ukemuha.

Aval ta chaze, beshaata devara kudesha berich hu leadam harishon. dechar venukeba itberiu, vahavu tarvavyyhu da im da kishura, nukeba laachora, udechura lekama, ad denasar lon kudesha berich hu, veatkin lah, veail lah lekammeh deadam, leistakkela anpin beanpin, vechevan deistakkelu anpin beanpin, keden itsagge rechimuta bealma, veolidu toladin bealma, ma dela havavt mikkadmat dena, veha okimna.

Ulevatar dechav adam veitteta, veata nachash al chavva, veatil bah zuhama, olidat chavva lekayin, vahava diyyukeneh, diyyukena dilella (167 amud alef) vetatta, meraza dezuhama desitra achara, umissitra diltatta. veal da ihu hava kadmaa, deavad mota bealma, begin desitra dileh garim. chivya orcheh hu lemeheve kamin lekatula, hahu deate minneh orcheh nakit veazil, veal da ketiv (Bereshit 4:8) vayhi bihyotam bassade vayyakam kayin el hevel achiv vayyahargehu.
